                };
                cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
                console.log(`Applied Dark Green to ${rawHeader}: ${percentage}%`);
              }
              
              cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center' };
            }
          } else {
            // For non-percentage columns, set center alignment for numeric values
            const cell = dataRow.getCell(colIndex + 1);
            if (typeof row[rawHeader] === 'number' || !isNaN(parseFloat(row[rawHeader]))) {
              cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center' };
            }
          }
        });
      });
      
      // Add legend rows
      const legendStartRow = processedData.data.length + 3; // Add some space after data
      
      // Add legend title
      const legendTitleRow = worksheet.addRow(['Legend:']);
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 12 };
      
      // Add legend items
      const legendRow1 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red: <75%']);
      const legendRow2 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber: 75% to 90%']);
      const legendRow3 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green: >=90%']);

      };
      redCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      
      const amberCell = legendRow2.getCell(1);
      amberCell.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' }
      };
      amberCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      
      const greenCell = legendRow3.getCell(1);
      greenCell.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FF16A34A' }
      };
      greenCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      
      // Set column widths
      headers.forEach((header, index) => {
        if (header === 'S No.') {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 10; // S No. column
        } else if (header.includes('CUSTOMER NAME') || header.includes('BUSSINESS UNIT')) {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 20;
        } else if (header.includes('%') || header.includes('Percentage')) {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 18;
        } else {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 15;
        }
      });
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `${sheetName}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
      console.log('Data exported successfully with color coding');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting data:', error);
      alert(`Error exporting data: ${error.message}. Please try again.`);
    }
  };

  const handleBuWiseToggle = () => {
    setShowBuWise(!showBuWise);
    setShowTop10(false);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    setCustomerNameSearch('');
    setBusinessUnitFilter('');
    setSortConfig({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  };

  const handleTop10Toggle = () => {
    setShowTop10(!showTop10);
    setShowBuWise(false);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    setCustomerNameSearch('');
    setBusinessUnitFilter('');
    setSortConfig({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  };

  // Color coding function for percentage columns
  const getPercentageCellStyle = (value, isPercentageColumn) => {
    if (!isPercentageColumn) return {};
    
    // Extract numeric value from percentage string (e.g., "25.50%" -> 25.50)
    const numericValue = parseFloat(value.replace('%', ''));
    
    if (numericValue < 75) {
      return { backgroundColor: '#dc2626', color: '#ffffff' }; // Dark Red - White text
    } else if (numericValue >= 75 && numericValue < 90) {
      return { backgroundColor: '#d97706', color: '#000000' }; // Dark Amber - Black text
    } else if (numericValue >= 90) {
      return { backgroundColor: '#16a34a', color: '#000000' }; // Dark Green - Black text
    }
    
    return {};
  };

  if (!uploadedData || uploadedData.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>Account/BU wise percentage of Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem' }}>
          No data available. Please upload an Excel file first.
        </div>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <ControlPanel>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>Account/BU wise percentage of Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <BuWiseButton onClick={handleBuWiseToggle}>
                {showBuWise ? 'Display Customer Wise' : 'Display BU Wise Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)'}
              </BuWiseButton>
              <BuWiseButton onClick={handleTop10Toggle}>
                {showTop10 ? 'Show All Accounts' : 'Top 10 account -percentage of Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)'}
              </BuWiseButton>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
              <DownloadButton onClick={handleDownload}>
                <Download size={20} />
                Download Excel
              </DownloadButton>
              <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
                <ArrowLeft size={20} />
                Back
              </BackButton>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </ControlPanel>

      <ResultsSummary>
        <strong>Results Summary:</strong> 
        {showBuWise 
          ? `Showing count of satisfied customers (ratings 4 or 5) for each perspective grouped by Business Unit. Excludes rows with 0 CSS surveys sent. Percentage columns: Timeline Adherence, Quality of Delivery, Risk Management & Responsiveness, Thought Leadership (based on Non Staffing surveys), Overall Experience, Timely Resource Fulfillment (based on Total surveys), Resource Competency (based on Staffing surveys). CSS data filtered by CSAT cycle start date (${csatCycleStartDateFormatted}). Total BUs: ${processedData.data.length},`
          : showTop10
          ? `Showing all customers with Top 10 indicator based on average percentage of satisfied customers (ratings 4 or 5) for each perspective. Excludes rows with 0 CSS surveys sent. Percentage columns: Timeline Adherence, Quality of Delivery, Risk Management & Responsiveness, Thought Leadership (based on Non Staffing surveys), Overall Experience, Timely Resource Fulfillment (based on Total surveys), Resource Competency (based on Staffing surveys). CSS data filtered by CSAT cycle start date (${csatCycleStartDateFormatted}). Total customers: ${processedData.data.length},`
          : `Showing count of satisfied customers (ratings 4 or 5) for each perspective. Filtered to show only Top 10 customers (Top 10="Y" from second sheet). Excludes rows with 0 CSS surveys sent. Percentage columns: Timeline Adherence, Quality of Delivery, Risk Management & Responsiveness, Thought Leadership (based on Non Staffing surveys), Overall Experience, Timely Resource Fulfillment (based on Total surveys), Resource Competency (based on Staffing surveys). CSS data filtered by CSAT cycle start date (${csatCycleStartDateFormatted}). Total customers: ${processedData.data.length},`
        }
        Total perspectives: {processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.length}
        {!showBuWise && customerNameSearch && ` (filtered by Customer Name: "${customerNameSearch}")`}
        {businessUnitFilter && ` (filtered by Business Unit: "${businessUnitFilter}")`}
      </ResultsSummary>

      <LegendContainer>
        <strong>Legend:</strong>
        <LegendItem>
          <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#ffebee', color: '#c62828' }}>Red</LegendColor>
          <span>&lt;75%</span>
        </LegendItem>
        <LegendItem>
          <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#fff3e0', color: '#ef6c00' }}>Amber</LegendColor>
          <span>75% - 90%</span>
        </LegendItem>
        <LegendItem>
          <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#e8f5e8', color: '#2e7d32' }}>Green</LegendColor>
          <span>&gt;=90%</span>
        </LegendItem>
      </LegendContainer>

      <FilterContainer>
        {!showBuWise && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
            <Search size={20} color="#6b7280" />
            <SearchInput
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by Customer Name..."
              value={customerNameSearch}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomerNameSearch(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: '#374151' }}>Filter by Business Unit:</label>
          <Select
            value={businessUnitFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setBusinessUnitFilter(e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">All Business Units</option>
            {processedData && Array.from(new Set(processedData.data.map(item => 
              showBuWise ? item['BUSSINESS UNIT'] : item.businessUnit
            )))
              .filter(bu => bu && bu !== 'N/A')
              .sort()
              .map(bu => (
                <option key={bu} value={bu}>{bu}</option>
              ))
            }
          </Select>
        </div>
      </FilterContainer>

      {/* Color Legend */}
      <div style={{ 
        margin: '1rem 0', 
        padding: '1rem', 
        background: '#f8fafc', 
        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', 
        borderRadius: '8px',
        display: 'flex',
        flexWrap: 'wrap',
        gap: '1rem',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center'
      }}>
        <span style={{ fontWeight: '600', color: '#374151', marginRight: '0.5rem' }}>Percentage Color Legend:</span>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <div style={{ 
            width: '20px', 
            height: '20px', 
            backgroundColor: '#dc2626', 
            border: '1px solid #dc2626',
            borderRadius: '4px'
          }}></div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: '#374151' }}>&lt;75% (Dark Red)</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <div style={{ 
            width: '20px', 
            height: '20px', 
            backgroundColor: '#d97706', 
            border: '1px solid #d97706',
            borderRadius: '4px'
          }}></div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: '#374151' }}>75% to 90% (Dark Amber)</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <div style={{ 
            width: '20px', 
            height: '20px', 
            backgroundColor: '#16a34a', 
            border: '1px solid #16a34a',
            borderRadius: '4px'
          }}></div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: '#374151' }}>&gt;=90% (Dark Green)</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <Th onClick={() => handleSort('sNo')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                S No. {sortConfig.key === 'sNo' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
              </Th>
              {!showBuWise && (
                <>
                  <Th onClick={() => handleSort('customerId')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    CUSTOMER_ID {sortConfig.key === 'customerId' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                  </Th>
                  <Th onClick={() => handleSort('customerName')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    CUSTOMER NAME {sortConfig.key === 'customerName' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                  </Th>
                </>
              )}
                             <Th onClick={() => handleSort(showBuWise ? 'BUSSINESS UNIT' : 'businessUnit')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                 BUSSINESS UNIT {sortConfig.key === (showBuWise ? 'BUSSINESS UNIT' : 'businessUnit') && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
               </Th>
               {showTop10 && (
                 <Th onClick={() => handleSort('top10')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                   Top 10 {sortConfig.key === 'top10' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                 </Th>
               )}
               <Th onClick={() => handleSort('cssSentCount')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                 Total Number of CSAT Surveys Sent {sortConfig.key === 'cssSentCount' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
               </Th>
               <Th onClick={() => handleSort('cssReceivedCount')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                 Total Number of CSAT Surveys Received {sortConfig.key === 'cssReceivedCount' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
               </Th>
               <Th onClick={() => handleSort('nonStaffingCount')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                 Total Surveys Received in Non Staffing {sortConfig.key === 'nonStaffingCount' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
               </Th>
               <Th onClick={() => handleSort('staffingCount')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                 Total Surveys Received in Staffing {sortConfig.key === 'staffingCount' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
               </Th>
                             {processedData && processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues && 
                 processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.map(perspectiveValue => {
                   const isPercentageColumn = ['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership', 'Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment', 'Resource Competency'].includes(perspectiveValue);
                   return (
                     <Th key={perspectiveValue} onClick={() => handleSort(perspectiveValue)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                       {perspectiveValue} {isPercentageColumn && '(%)'} {sortConfig.key === perspectiveValue && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                     </Th>
                   );
                 })
               }
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {currentData.length > 0 ? (
              currentData.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  {!showBuWise && (
                    <>
                      <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                      <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                    </>
                  )}
                                     <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{showBuWise ? row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] : row.businessUnit}</Td>
                   {showTop10 && <Td>{row.top10}</Td>}
                   <Td>{row.cssSentCount}</Td>
                   <Td>{row.cssReceivedCount}</Td>
                   <Td>{row.nonStaffingCount || 0}</Td>
                   <Td>{row.staffingCount || 0}</Td>
                                     {processedData && processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues && 
                     processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.map(perspectiveValue => {
                       const isPercentageColumn = ['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership', 'Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment', 'Resource Competency'].includes(perspectiveValue);
                       const cellStyle = getPercentageCellStyle(row[perspectiveValue] || '0.00%', isPercentageColumn);
                       return (
                         <Td key={perspectiveValue} style={cellStyle}>
                           {isPercentageColumn ? (row[perspectiveValue] || '0.00%') : (row[perspectiveValue] || '0')}
                         </Td>
                       );
                     })
                   }
                </tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <tr>
                                 <td colSpan={
                   processedData && processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues ? 
                   (showBuWise ? (6 + processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.length) : 
                    (showTop10 ? (9 + processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.length) : (8 + processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.length))) : 
                   (showBuWise ? 6 : (showTop10 ? 9 : 8))
                 } style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem' }}>
                  No data found
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>

      {totalPages > 1 && (
        <PaginationContainer>
          <PageButton
            onClick={() => setCurrentPage(1)}
            disabled={currentPage === 1}
          >
            First
          </PageButton>
          <PageButton
            onClick={() => setCurrentPage(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, 1))}
            disabled={currentPage === 1}
          >
            Previous
          </PageButton>
          
          {Array.from({ length: Math.min(5, totalPages) }, (_, i) => {
            let pageNum;
            if (totalPages <= 5) {
              pageNum = i + 1;
            } else if (currentPage <= 3) {
              pageNum = i + 1;
            } else if (currentPage >= totalPages - 2) {
              pageNum = totalPages - 4 + i;
            } else {
              pageNum = currentPage - 2 + i;
            }
            
            return (
              <PageButton
                key={pageNum}
                onClick={() => setCurrentPage(pageNum)}
                className={currentPage === pageNum ? 'active' : ''}
              >
                {pageNum}
              </PageButton>
            );
          })}
          
          <PageButton
            onClick={() => setCurrentPage(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, totalPages))}
            disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
          >
            Next
          </PageButton>
          <PageButton
            onClick={() => setCurrentPage(totalPages)}
            disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
          >
            Last
          </PageButton>
        </PaginationContainer>
      )}
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default SatisfiedCustomersEachPerspectiveDashboard;

const SatisfiedCustomersEachPerspectiveDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [uploadedData, setUploadedData] = useState([]);
  const [customerNameSearch, setCustomerNameSearch] = useState('');
  const [businessUnitFilter, setBusinessUnitFilter] = useState('');
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [showBuWise, setShowBuWise] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10, setShowTop10] = useState(false);
  const itemsPerPage = 20;
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (excelData && excelData.data && Array.isArray(excelData.data)) {
      setUploadedData(excelData.data);
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Helper function for date comparison
  const isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart = (dateValue) => {
    if (!csatCycleStartDateFormatted || !dateValue) return true;
    
    try {
      let date;
      
      // Handle different date formats
      if (typeof dateValue === 'string') {
        // If it's already in MM-DD-YYYY format
        if (/^\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{4}$/.test(dateValue)) {
          const [month, day, year] = dateValue.split('-').map(Number);
          date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
        }
        // If it's in other formats, try to parse
        else {
          date = new Date(dateValue);
        }
      } else if (typeof dateValue === 'number') {
        // Handle Excel serial dates
        const epoch = new Date(Date.UTC(1899, 11, 30));
        const ms = Math.round(dateValue * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        date = new Date(epoch.getTime() + ms);
      } else {
        date = new Date(dateValue);
      }
      
      // Parse CSAT start date (MM-DD-YYYY format)
      const [mm, dd, yyyy] = csatCycleStartDateFormatted.split('-').map(Number);
      const csatStartDate = new Date(yyyy, mm - 1, dd);
      
      // Compare dates (ignore time)
      const dateOnly = new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate());
      const startDateOnly = new Date(csatStartDate.getFullYear(), csatStartDate.getMonth(), csatStartDate.getDate());
      
      return dateOnly >= startDateOnly;
    } catch (error) {
      console.log('Date parsing error:', error, 'for value:', dateValue);
      return true;
    }
  };

  const processBuWiseData = () => {
    if (!uploadedData || !Array.isArray(uploadedData) || uploadedData.length === 0) {
      return { data: [], allUniquePerspectiveValues: [] };
    }

    // Find the PERSPECTIVE column

    // Merge CSS counts
    Object.values(customerGroups).forEach((customerData) => {
      const customerId = customerData.customerId;
      const cssCounts = customerCSSCounts.get(customerId) || { cssSentCount: 0, cssReceivedCount: 0 };
      const nonStaffingCount = customerNonStaffingCounts.get(customerId) || 0;
      const staffingCount = customerStaffingCounts.get(customerId) || 0;
      
      customerData.cssSentCount = cssCounts.cssSentCount;
      customerData.cssReceivedCount = cssCounts.cssReceivedCount;
      customerData.nonStaffingCount = nonStaffingCount;
      customerData.staffingCount = staffingCount;
    });

    // Convert to array format and filter out rows with 0 CSS surveys sent
    const result = Object.values(customerGroups)
      .filter(obj => obj.cssSentCount > 0) // Filter out rows with 0 CSS surveys sent
      .map((obj, index) => {
        const row = {
          sNo: index + 1,
          customerId: obj.customerId,
          customerName: obj.customerName,
          businessUnit: obj.businessUnit,
          cssSentCount: obj.cssSentCount,
          cssReceivedCount: obj.cssReceivedCount,
          nonStaffingCount: obj.nonStaffingCount,
          staffingCount: obj.staffingCount
        };

      // Add counts for each perspective
      perspectiveValues.forEach(pv => {
        const count = obj[pv] || 0;
        const nonStaffingCount = obj.nonStaffingCount || 0;
        const totalReceivedCount = obj.cssReceivedCount || 0;
        const staffingCount = obj.staffingCount || 0;
        
        // Calculate percentage based on perspective type
        if (['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership'].includes(pv)) {
          // Use non-staffing surveys as denominator
          if (nonStaffingCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / nonStaffingCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else if (['Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment'].includes(pv)) {
          // Use total surveys received as denominator
          if (totalReceivedCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / totalReceivedCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else if (pv === 'Resource Competency') {
          // Use staffing surveys as denominator
          if (staffingCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / staffingCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else {
          // Show raw count for other perspectives
          row[pv] = count;
        }
      });

      return row;
    });

    return { data: result, allUniquePerspectiveValues: perspectiveValues };
  }, [uploadedData, showBuWise, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = processedData.data;

    if (showBuWise) {
      // For BU-wise view, only apply business unit filter
      if (businessUnitFilter) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(item => 
          (item['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || '').toLowerCase().includes(businessUnitFilter.toLowerCase())
        );
      }
    } else {
      // For customer-wise view, apply both filters
      if (customerNameSearch) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(item => 
          (item.customerName || '').toLowerCase().includes(customerNameSearch.toLowerCase())
        );
      }
      if (businessUnitFilter) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(item => 
          (item.businessUnit || '').toLowerCase().includes(businessUnitFilter.toLowerCase())
        );
      }
    }

    // Custom sorting for Top 10 accounts
    if (showTop10 && !showBuWise) {
      const top10Order = [
        'Premier Healthcare Solutions Inc (L80)',
        'Blue Cross Blue Shield Association BCBSA',
        'Frontier Airlines INC',
        'Tufts Medicine',
        'Premier - Horizon II - Covenant Health',
        'AgFirst Farm Credit Bank',
        'embecta MEDICAL II LLC',
        'Avaya LLC',
        'Northern Trust Company',
        'Jewish Board of Family and Childrens Services'
      ];
      
      filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const indexA = top10Order.indexOf(a.customerName);
        const indexB = top10Order.indexOf(b.customerName);
        
        // If both are in the predefined order, sort by that order
        if (indexA !== -1 && indexB !== -1) {
          return indexA - indexB;
        }
        // If only one is in the predefined order, prioritize it
        if (indexA !== -1) return -1;
        if (indexB !== -1) return 1;
        // If neither is in the predefined order, sort alphabetically
        return a.customerName.localeCompare(b.customerName);
      });
      
      // Update S No. after custom sorting
      filtered = filtered.map((item, index) => ({
        ...item,
        sNo: index + 1
      }));
    }

    return filtered;
  }, [processedData.data, customerNameSearch, businessUnitFilter, showBuWise, showTop10]);

  const sortedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!sortConfig.key) return filteredData;

    // If sorting by BUSSINESS UNIT, use our custom order
    if (sortConfig.key === 'BUSSINESS UNIT' || sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit') {
      const businessUnitOrder = ['Health care', 'New Growth', 'Tech', 'India & UK'];
      const sorted = [...filteredData].sort((a, b) => {
        const businessUnitKey = showBuWise ? 'BUSSINESS UNIT' : 'businessUnit';
        const aValue = a[businessUnitKey];
        const bValue = b[businessUnitKey];
        
        const indexA = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(aValue);
        const indexB = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(bValue);
        
        // If both are in the predefined order, sort by that order
        if (indexA !== -1 && indexB !== -1) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? indexA - indexB : indexB - indexA;
        }
        // If only one is in the predefined order, prioritize it
        if (indexA !== -1) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        if (indexB !== -1) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        // If neither is in the predefined order, sort alphabetically
        return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 
          aValue.localeCompare(bValue) : 
          bValue.localeCompare(aValue);
      });
      
      // Update S No. after sorting
      return sorted.map((item, index) => ({
        ...item,
        sNo: index + 1
      }));
    }

    // For other columns, sort normally but maintain Business Unit order as secondary sort
    const sorted = [...filteredData].sort((a, b) => {
      let aValue = a[sortConfig.key];
      let bValue = b[sortConfig.key];

      // Handle numeric values
      if (typeof aValue === 'number' && typeof bValue === 'number') {
        const result = sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? aValue - bValue : bValue - aValue;
        if (result !== 0) return result;
      } else {
        // Handle string values
        aValue = String(aValue || '').toLowerCase();
        bValue = String(bValue || '').toLowerCase();

        if (aValue < bValue) {
          const result = sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
          if (result !== 0) return result;
        }
        if (aValue > bValue) {
          const result = sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
          if (result !== 0) return result;
        }
      }
      
      // If values are equal, maintain Business Unit order
      const businessUnitOrder = ['Health care', 'New Growth', 'Tech', 'India & UK'];
      const businessUnitKey = showBuWise ? 'BUSSINESS UNIT' : 'businessUnit';
      const aBuValue = a[businessUnitKey];
      const bBuValue = b[businessUnitKey];
      
      const indexA = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(aBuValue);
      const indexB = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(bBuValue);
      
      if (indexA !== -1 && indexB !== -1) {
        return indexA - indexB;
      }
      if (indexA !== -1) return -1;
      if (indexB !== -1) return 1;
      return aBuValue.localeCompare(bBuValue);
    });
    
    // Update S No. after sorting
    return sorted.map((item, index) => ({
      ...item,
      sNo: index + 1
    }));
  }, [filteredData, sortConfig, showBuWise]);

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(sortedData.length / itemsPerPage);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
  const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
  const currentData = sortedData.slice(startIndex, endIndex);

  const handleSort = (key) => {
    setSortConfig(prev => ({
      key,
      direction: prev.key === key && prev.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'
    }));
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  const handleDownload = async () => {
    if (!processedData || !processedData.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      let sheetName;
      if (showBuWise) {
        sheetName = 'BU_Wise_Satisfied_Customers';
      } else if (showTop10) {
        sheetName = 'Top_10_Account_Satisfied_Customers';
      } else {
        sheetName = 'Customer_Wise_Satisfied_Customers';
      }
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet(sheetName);
      
      // Create ordered headers array with S No. first
      const firstRow = processedData.data[0];
      const rawHeaders = ['sNo', ...Object.keys(firstRow).filter(key => key !== 'sNo')];
      
      // Map raw column names to display names for Excel headers
      const headerMapping = {
        'sNo': 'S No.',
        'customerId': 'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'customerName': 'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'businessUnit': 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT': 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'top10': 'Top 10',
        'cssSentCount': 'Total Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'cssReceivedCount': 'Total Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'nonStaffingCount': 'Total Surveys Received in Non Staffing',
        'staffingCount': 'Total Surveys Received in Staffing'
      };
      
      // Create display headers for Excel
      const headers = rawHeaders.map(header => headerMapping[header] || header);
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows with color coding for percentage columns
      processedData.data.forEach((row, index) => {
        // Create ordered row data to ensure S No. is first
        // Use rawHeaders to access the data, but headers for display
        const orderedRowData = rawHeaders.map(rawHeader => row[rawHeader]);
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow(orderedRowData);
        
        // Apply color coding to percentage columns
        rawHeaders.forEach((rawHeader, colIndex) => {
          // Check if this is a percentage column by looking for specific perspective names
          const isPercentageColumn = [
            'Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 
            'Thought Leadership', 'Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment', 
            'Resource Competency'
          ].includes(rawHeader) || rawHeader.includes('%') || rawHeader.includes('Percentage');
          
          if (isPercentageColumn) {
            // Extract numeric value from percentage string (e.g., "25.50%" -> 25.50)
            const percentageValue = row[rawHeader];
            const percentage = parseFloat(percentageValue.toString().replace('%', ''));
            const cell = dataRow.getCell(colIndex + 1);
            
            console.log(`Processing column ${rawHeader}: value=${percentageValue}, parsed=${percentage}`);
            
            if (!isNaN(percentage)) {
              if (percentage < 75) {
                // Dark Red
                cell.fill = {
                  type: 'pattern',
                  pattern: 'solid',
                  fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' }
                };
                cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
                console.log(`Applied Dark Red to ${rawHeader}: ${percentage}%`);
              } else if (percentage >= 75 && percentage < 90) {
                // Dark Amber
                cell.fill = {
                  type: 'pattern',
                  pattern: 'solid',
                  fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' }
                };
                cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
                console.log(`Applied Dark Amber to ${rawHeader}: ${percentage}%`);
              } else if (percentage >= 90) {
                // Dark Green
                cell.fill = {
                  type: 'pattern',
                  pattern: 'solid',
                  fgColor: { argb: 'FF16A34A' }
                };
                cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
                console.log(`Applied Dark Green to ${rawHeader}: ${percentage}%`);
              }
              
              cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center' };
            }
          } else {
            // For non-percentage columns, set center alignment for numeric values
            const cell = dataRow.getCell(colIndex + 1);
            if (typeof row[rawHeader] === 'number' || !isNaN(parseFloat(row[rawHeader]))) {
              cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center' };
            }
          }
        });
      });
      
      // Add legend rows
      const legendStartRow = processedData.data.length + 3; // Add some space after data
      
      // Add legend title
      const legendTitleRow = worksheet.addRow(['Legend:']);
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 12 };
      
      // Add legend items
      const legendRow1 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red: <75%']);
      const legendRow2 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber: 75% to 90%']);
      const legendRow3 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green: >=90%']);
      
      // Style legend cells with colors
      const redCell = legendRow1.getCell(1);
      redCell.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' }
      };
      redCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      
      const amberCell = legendRow2.getCell(1);
      amberCell.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' }
      };
      amberCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      
      const greenCell = legendRow3.getCell(1);
      greenCell.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FF16A34A' }
      };
      greenCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      
      // Set column widths
      headers.forEach((header, index) => {
        if (header === 'S No.') {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 10; // S No. column
        } else if (header.includes('CUSTOMER NAME') || header.includes('BUSSINESS UNIT')) {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 20;
        } else if (header.includes('%') || header.includes('Percentage')) {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 18;
        } else {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 15;
        }
      });
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `${sheetName}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
      console.log('Data exported successfully with color coding');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting data:', error);
      alert(`Error exporting data: ${error.message}. Please try again.`);
    }
  };

  const handleBuWiseToggle = () => {
    setShowBuWise(!showBuWise);
    setShowTop10(false);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    setCustomerNameSearch('');
    setBusinessUnitFilter('');
    setSortConfig({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  };

  const handleTop10Toggle = () => {
    setShowTop10(!showTop10);
    setShowBuWise(false);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    setCustomerNameSearch('');
    setBusinessUnitFilter('');
    setSortConfig({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  };

  // Color coding function for percentage columns
  const getPercentageCellStyle = (value, isPercentageColumn) => {
    if (!isPercentageColumn) return {};
    
    // Extract numeric value from percentage string (e.g., "25.50%" -> 25.50)
    const numericValue = parseFloat(value.replace('%', ''));
    
    if (numericValue < 75) {
      return { backgroundColor: '#dc2626', color: '#ffffff' }; // Dark Red - White text
    } else if (numericValue >= 75 && numericValue < 90) {
      return { backgroundColor: '#d97706', color: '#000000' }; // Dark Amber - Black text
    } else if (numericValue >= 90) {
      return { backgroundColor: '#16a34a', color: '#000000' }; // Dark Green - Black text
    }
    
    return {};
  };

  if (!uploadedData || uploadedData.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>Account/BU wise percentage of Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem' }}>
          No data available. Please upload an Excel file first.
        </div>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <ControlPanel>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>Account/BU wise percentage of Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <BuWiseButton onClick={handleBuWiseToggle}>
                {showBuWise ? 'Display Customer Wise' : 'Display BU Wise Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)'}
              </BuWiseButton>
              <BuWiseButton onClick={handleTop10Toggle}>
                {showTop10 ? 'Show All Accounts' : 'Top 10 account -percentage of Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)'}
              </BuWiseButton>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
              <DownloadButton onClick={handleDownload}>
                <Download size={20} />
                Download Excel
              </DownloadButton>
              <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
                <ArrowLeft size={20} />
                Back
              </BackButton>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </ControlPanel>

      <ResultsSummary>
        <strong>Results Summary:</strong> 
        {showBuWise 
          ? `Showing count of satisfied customers (ratings 4 or 5) for each perspective grouped by Business Unit. Excludes rows with 0 CSS surveys sent. Percentage columns: Timeline Adherence, Quality of Delivery, Risk Management & Responsiveness, Thought Leadership (based on Non Staffing surveys), Overall Experience, Timely Resource Fulfillment (based on Total surveys), Resource Competency (based on Staffing surveys). CSS data filtered by CSAT cycle start date (${csatCycleStartDateFormatted}). Total BUs: ${processedData.data.length},`
          : showTop10
          ? `Showing all customers with Top 10 indicator based on average percentage of satisfied customers (ratings 4 or 5) for each perspective. Excludes rows with 0 CSS surveys sent. Percentage columns: Timeline Adherence, Quality of Delivery, Risk Management & Responsiveness, Thought Leadership (based on Non Staffing surveys), Overall Experience, Timely Resource Fulfillment (based on Total surveys), Resource Competency (based on Staffing surveys). CSS data filtered by CSAT cycle start date (${csatCycleStartDateFormatted}). Total customers: ${processedData.data.length},`
          : `Showing count of satisfied customers (ratings 4 or 5) for each perspective. Filtered to show only Top 10 customers (Top 10="Y" from second sheet). Excludes rows with 0 CSS surveys sent. Percentage columns: Timeline Adherence, Quality of Delivery, Risk Management & Responsiveness, Thought Leadership (based on Non Staffing surveys), Overall Experience, Timely Resource Fulfillment (based on Total surveys), Resource Competency (based on Staffing surveys). CSS data filtered by CSAT cycle start date (${csatCycleStartDateFormatted}). Total customers: ${processedData.data.length},`
        }
        Total perspectives: {processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.length}
        {!showBuWise && customerNameSearch && ` (filtered by Customer Name: "${customerNameSearch}")`}
        {businessUnitFilter && ` (filtered by Business Unit: "${businessUnitFilter}")`}
      </ResultsSummary>

      <LegendContainer>
        <strong>Legend:</strong>
        <LegendItem>
          <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#ffebee', color: '#c62828' }}>Red</LegendColor>
          <span>&lt;75%</span>
        </LegendItem>
        <LegendItem>
          <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#fff3e0', color: '#ef6c00' }}>Amber</LegendColor>
          <span>75% - 90%</span>
        </LegendItem>
        <LegendItem>
          <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#e8f5e8', color: '#2e7d32' }}>Green</LegendColor>
          <span>&gt;=90%</span>
        </LegendItem>
      </LegendContainer>

      <FilterContainer>
        {!showBuWise && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
            <Search size={20} color="#6b7280" />
            <SearchInput
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by Customer Name..."
              value={customerNameSearch}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomerNameSearch(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: '#374151' }}>Filter by Business Unit:</label>
          <Select
            value={businessUnitFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setBusinessUnitFilter(e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">All Business Units</option>
            {processedData && Array.from(new Set(processedData.data.map(item => 
              showBuWise ? item['BUSSINESS UNIT'] : item.businessUnit
            )))
              .filter(bu => bu && bu !== 'N/A')
              .sort()
              .map(bu => (
                <option key={bu} value={bu}>{bu}</option>
              ))
            }
          </Select>
        </div>
      </FilterContainer>

      {/* Color Legend */}
      <div style={{ 
        margin: '1rem 0', 
        padding: '1rem', 
        background: '#f8fafc', 
        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', 
        borderRadius: '8px',
        display: 'flex',
        flexWrap: 'wrap',
        gap: '1rem',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center'
      }}>
        <span style={{ fontWeight: '600', color: '#374151', marginRight: '0.5rem' }}>Percentage Color Legend:</span>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <div style={{ 
            width: '20px', 
            height: '20px', 
            backgroundColor: '#dc2626', 
            border: '1px solid #dc2626',
            borderRadius: '4px'
          }}></div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: '#374151' }}>&lt;75% (Dark Red)</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <div style={{ 
            width: '20px', 
            height: '20px', 
            backgroundColor: '#d97706', 
            border: '1px solid #d97706',
            borderRadius: '4px'
          }}></div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: '#374151' }}>75% to 90% (Dark Amber)</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <div style={{ 
            width: '20px', 
            height: '20px', 
            backgroundColor: '#16a34a', 
            border: '1px solid #16a34a',
            borderRadius: '4px'
          }}></div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: '#374151' }}>&gt;=90% (Dark Green)</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <Th onClick={() => handleSort('sNo')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                S No. {sortConfig.key === 'sNo' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
              </Th>
              {!showBuWise && (
                <>
                  <Th onClick={() => handleSort('customerId')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    CUSTOMER_ID {sortConfig.key === 'customerId' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                  </Th>
                  <Th onClick={() => handleSort('customerName')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    CUSTOMER NAME {sortConfig.key === 'customerName' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                  </Th>
                </>
              )}
                             <Th onClick={() => handleSort(showBuWise ? 'BUSSINESS UNIT' : 'businessUnit')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                 BUSSINESS UNIT {sortConfig.key === (showBuWise ? 'BUSSINESS UNIT' : 'businessUnit') && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
               </Th>
               {showTop10 && (
                 <Th onClick={() => handleSort('top10')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                   Top 10 {sortConfig.key === 'top10' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                 </Th>
               )}
               <Th onClick={() => handleSort('cssSentCount')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                 Total Number of CSAT Surveys Sent {sortConfig.key === 'cssSentCount' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
               </Th>
               <Th onClick={() => handleSort('cssReceivedCount')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                 Total Number of CSAT Surveys Received {sortConfig.key === 'cssReceivedCount' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
               </Th>
               <Th onClick={() => handleSort('nonStaffingCount')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                 Total Surveys Received in Non Staffing {sortConfig.key === 'nonStaffingCount' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
               </Th>
               <Th onClick={() => handleSort('staffingCount')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                 Total Surveys Received in Staffing {sortConfig.key === 'staffingCount' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
               </Th>
                             {processedData && processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues && 
                 processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.map(perspectiveValue => {
                   const isPercentageColumn = ['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership', 'Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment', 'Resource Competency'].includes(perspectiveValue);
                   return (
                     <Th key={perspectiveValue} onClick={() => handleSort(perspectiveValue)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                       {perspectiveValue} {isPercentageColumn && '(%)'} {sortConfig.key === perspectiveValue && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                     </Th>
                   );
                 })
               }
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {currentData.length > 0 ? (
              currentData.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  {!showBuWise && (
                    <>
                      <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                      <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                    </>
                  )}
                                     <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{showBuWise ? row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] : row.businessUnit}</Td>
                   {showTop10 && <Td>{row.top10}</Td>}
                   <Td>{row.cssSentCount}</Td>
                   <Td>{row.cssReceivedCount}</Td>
                   <Td>{row.nonStaffingCount || 0}</Td>
                   <Td>{row.staffingCount || 0}</Td>
                                     {processedData && processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues && 
                     processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.map(perspectiveValue => {
                       const isPercentageColumn = ['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership', 'Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment', 'Resource Competency'].includes(perspectiveValue);
                       const cellStyle = getPercentageCellStyle(row[perspectiveValue] || '0.00%', isPercentageColumn);
                       return (
                         <Td key={perspectiveValue} style={cellStyle}>
                           {isPercentageColumn ? (row[perspectiveValue] || '0.00%') : (row[perspectiveValue] || '0')}
                         </Td>
                       );
                     })
                   }
                </tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <tr>
                                 <td colSpan={
                   processedData && processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues ? 
                   (showBuWise ? (6 + processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.length) : 
                    (showTop10 ? (9 + processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.length) : (8 + processedData.allUniquePerspectiveValues.length))) : 
                   (showBuWise ? 6 : (showTop10 ? 9 : 8))
                 } style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem' }}>
                  No data found
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>

      {totalPages > 1 && (
        <PaginationContainer>
          <PageButton
            onClick={() => setCurrentPage(1)}
            disabled={currentPage === 1}
          >
            First
          </PageButton>
          <PageButton
            onClick={() => setCurrentPage(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, 1))}
            disabled={currentPage === 1}
          >
            Previous
          </PageButton>
          
          {Array.from({ length: Math.min(5, totalPages) }, (_, i) => {
            let pageNum;
            if (totalPages <= 5) {
              pageNum = i + 1;
            } else if (currentPage <= 3) {
              pageNum = i + 1;
            } else if (currentPage >= totalPages - 2) {
              pageNum = totalPages - 4 + i;
            } else {
              pageNum = currentPage - 2 + i;
            }
            
            return (
              <PageButton
                key={pageNum}
                onClick={() => setCurrentPage(pageNum)}
                className={currentPage === pageNum ? 'active' : ''}
              >
                {pageNum}
              </PageButton>
            );
          })}
          
          <PageButton
            onClick={() => setCurrentPage(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, totalPages))}
            disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
          >
            Next
          </PageButton>
          <PageButton
            onClick={() => setCurrentPage(totalPages)}
            disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
          >
            Last
          </PageButton>
        </PaginationContainer>
      )}
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default SatisfiedCustomersEachPerspectiveDashboard;

const SatisfiedCustomersEachPerspectiveDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [uploadedData, setUploadedData] = useState([]);
  const [customerNameSearch, setCustomerNameSearch] = useState('');
  const [businessUnitFilter, setBusinessUnitFilter] = useState('');
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [showBuWise, setShowBuWise] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10, setShowTop10] = useState(false);
  const itemsPerPage = 20;
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (excelData && excelData.data && Array.isArray(excelData.data)) {
      setUploadedData(excelData.data);
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Helper function for date comparison
  const isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart = (dateValue) => {
    if (!csatCycleStartDateFormatted || !dateValue) return true;
    
    try {
      let date;
      
      // Handle different date formats
      if (typeof dateValue === 'string') {
        // If it's already in MM-DD-YYYY format
        if (/^\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{4}$/.test(dateValue)) {
          const [month, day, year] = dateValue.split('-').map(Number);
          date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
        }
        // If it's in other formats, try to parse
        else {
          date = new Date(dateValue);
        }
      } else if (typeof dateValue === 'number') {
        // Handle Excel serial dates
        const epoch = new Date(Date.UTC(1899, 11, 30));
        const ms = Math.round(dateValue * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        date = new Date(epoch.getTime() + ms);
      } else {
        date = new Date(dateValue);
      }
      
      // Parse CSAT start date (MM-DD-YYYY format)
      const [mm, dd, yyyy] = csatCycleStartDateFormatted.split('-').map(Number);
      const csatStartDate = new Date(yyyy, mm - 1, dd);
      
      // Compare dates (ignore time)
      const dateOnly = new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate());
      const startDateOnly = new Date(csatStartDate.getFullYear(), csatStartDate.getMonth(), csatStartDate.getDate());
      
      return dateOnly >= startDateOnly;
    } catch (error) {
      console.log('Date parsing error:', error, 'for value:', dateValue);
      return true;
    }
  };

  const processBuWiseData = () => {
    if (!uploadedData || !Array.isArray(uploadedData) || uploadedData.length === 0) {
      return { data: [], allUniquePerspectiveValues: [] };
    }

    // Find the PERSPECTIVE column
    const perspectiveColumn = Object.keys(uploadedData[0]).find(key => 
      key.toLowerCase().includes('perspective')
    );

    if (!perspectiveColumn) {
      console.log('No PERSPECTIVE column found');
      return { data: [], allUniquePerspectiveValues: [] };
    }

    // Get unique perspective values
    const uniquePerspectiveValues = [...new Set(uploadedData.map(row => row[perspectiveColumn]))]
      .filter(value => value && value !== 'Qualitative Feedback' && isNaN(value));

    // Group data by BUSSINESS UNIT
    const buGroups = {};
    const buCssCounts = new Map();
    const buNonStaffingCounts = new Map();
    const buStaffingCounts = new Map();

    // Process CSS counts for each BU from second sheet
    if (excelData.secondSheetData && Array.isArray(excelData.secondSheetData)) {
      const cssSentColumn = Object.keys(excelData.secondSheetData[0] || {}).find(key => 
        key.toLowerCase().includes('css_sent_date')
      );
      const cssReceivedColumn = Object.keys(excelData.secondSheetData[0] || {}).find(key => 
        key.toLowerCase().includes('css_received_date')
      );
      const buColumn = Object.keys(excelData.secondSheetData[0] || {}).find(key => 
        key === 'BUSSINESS UNIT' || 
        key === 'Business Unit' ||
        key.toLowerCase() === 'bussiness unit' ||
        key.toLowerCase() === 'business unit'
      );
      const revenueTypeColumn = Object.keys(excelData.secondSheetData[0] || {}).find(key => 
        key === 'REVENUE_TYPE' || 
        key === 'Revenue Type' ||
        key.toLowerCase() === 'revenue_type' ||
        key.toLowerCase() === 'revenue type'
      );

      console.log('BU-wise CSS columns found:', { cssSentColumn, cssReceivedColumn, buColumn, revenueTypeColumn });
      console.log('CSAT Cycle Start Date:', csatCycleStartDateFormatted);
      console.log('Second sheet sample row:', excelData.secondSheetData[0]);
      console.log('All second sheet columns:', Object.keys(excelData.secondSheetData[0] || {}));

      excelData.secondSheetData.forEach((secondRow, index) => {
        let bu = 'Unknown';
        
        if (buColumn && secondRow[buColumn]) {
          bu = secondRow[buColumn];
        } else {
          // Fallback: try to find business unit from first sheet using customer ID
          const customerIdColumn = Object.keys(secondRow).find(key => 
            key.toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || key.toLowerCase().includes('cust_id')
          );
          if (customerIdColumn && secondRow[customerIdColumn]) {
            const customerId = secondRow[customerIdColumn];
            const firstSheetRow = uploadedData.find(row => 
              (row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || row['CUST_ID']) === customerId
            );
            if (firstSheetRow) {
              bu = firstSheetRow['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || firstSheetRow['Business Unit'] || 'Unknown';
            }
          }
        }
        
        if (!buCssCounts.has(bu)) {
          buCssCounts.set(bu, { cssSentCount: 0, cssReceivedCount: 0 });
        }
        if (!buNonStaffingCounts.has(bu)) {
          buNonStaffingCounts.set(bu, 0);
        }
        if (!buStaffingCounts.has(bu)) {
          buStaffingCounts.set(bu, 0);
        }

        if (cssSentColumn && secondRow[cssSentColumn]) {
          const cssSentDate = secondRow[cssSentColumn];
          if (cssSentDate && cssSentDate !== '' && cssSentDate !== 'N/A' && cssSentDate !== null && cssSentDate !== undefined) {
            const isAfterStart = isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart(cssSentDate);
            if (isAfterStart) {
              buCssCounts.get(bu).cssSentCount++;
            }
            if (index < 3) { // Debug first 3 rows
              console.log(`Row ${index}: BU=${bu}, CSS_SENT_DATE=${cssSentDate}, isAfterStart=${isAfterStart}, count=${buCssCounts.get(bu).cssSentCount}`);
            }
          }
        }
        if (cssReceivedColumn && secondRow[cssReceivedColumn]) {
          const cssReceivedDate = secondRow[cssReceivedColumn];
          if (cssReceivedDate && cssReceivedDate !== '' && cssReceivedDate !== 'N/A' && cssReceivedDate !== null && cssReceivedDate !== undefined) {
            const isAfterStart = isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart(cssReceivedDate);
            if (isAfterStart) {
              buCssCounts.get(bu).cssReceivedCount++;
              
              // Count staffing vs non-staffing based on REVENUE_TYPE
              const revenueType = revenueTypeColumn ? secondRow[revenueTypeColumn] : '';
              if (revenueType === 'Fixed Monthly') {
                buStaffingCounts.set(bu, buStaffingCounts.get(bu) + 1);
              } else if (['Time and Material', 'Fixed Bid', 'Managed Services'].includes(revenueType)) {
                buNonStaffingCounts.set(bu, buNonStaffingCounts.get(bu) + 1);
              }
            }
            if (index < 3) { // Debug first 3 rows
              const revenueType = revenueTypeColumn ? secondRow[revenueTypeColumn] : '';
              console.log(`Row ${index}: BU=${bu}, CSS_RECEIVED_DATE=${cssReceivedDate}, REVENUE_TYPE=${revenueType}, isAfterStart=${isAfterStart}, count=${buCssCounts.get(bu).cssReceivedCount}`);
            }
          }
        }
      });
      
      console.log('Final BU CSS counts:', Array.from(buCssCounts.entries()));
    }

    // Process first sheet data grouped by BU
    uploadedData.forEach(row => {
      const bu = row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || row['Business Unit'] || 'Unknown';
      const perspective = row[perspectiveColumn];
      const rating = row['RATING'];

      if (!buGroups[bu]) {
        buGroups[bu] = {};
        uniquePerspectiveValues.forEach(pv => {
          buGroups[bu][pv] = 0;
        });
      }

      if (perspective && uniquePerspectiveValues.includes(perspective) && (rating === 4 || rating === 5)) {
        buGroups[bu][perspective]++;
      }
    });

    // Convert to array format and filter out rows with 0 CSS surveys sent
    const result = Object.keys(buGroups)
      .filter(bu => {
        const cssCounts = buCssCounts.get(bu) || { cssSentCount: 0, cssReceivedCount: 0 };
        return cssCounts.cssSentCount > 0; // Filter out rows with 0 CSS surveys sent
      })
      .map((bu, index) => {
        const buData = buGroups[bu];
        const cssCounts = buCssCounts.get(bu) || { cssSentCount: 0, cssReceivedCount: 0 };
        const nonStaffingCount = buNonStaffingCounts.get(bu) || 0;
        const staffingCount = buStaffingCounts.get(bu) || 0;
        
        const row = {
          sNo: index + 1,
          'BUSSINESS UNIT': bu,
          cssSentCount: cssCounts.cssSentCount,
          cssReceivedCount: cssCounts.cssReceivedCount,
          nonStaffingCount: nonStaffingCount,
          staffingCount: staffingCount
        };

      // Add counts for each perspective
      uniquePerspectiveValues.forEach(pv => {
        const count = buData[pv] || 0;
        const totalReceivedCount = cssCounts.cssReceivedCount || 0;
        
        // Calculate percentage based on perspective type
        if (['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership'].includes(pv)) {
          // Use non-staffing surveys as denominator
          if (nonStaffingCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / nonStaffingCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else if (['Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment'].includes(pv)) {
          // Use total surveys received as denominator
          if (totalReceivedCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / totalReceivedCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else if (pv === 'Resource Competency') {
          // Use staffing surveys as denominator
          if (staffingCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / staffingCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else {
          // Show raw count for other perspectives
          row[pv] = count;
        }
      });

      return row;
    });

    // Sort by custom Business Unit order
    const businessUnitOrder = ['Health care', 'New Growth', 'Tech', 'India & UK'];
    const sortedResult = result.sort((a, b) => {
      const indexA = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(a['BUSSINESS UNIT']);
      const indexB = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(b['BUSSINESS UNIT']);
      
      // If both are in the predefined order, sort by that order
      if (indexA !== -1 && indexB !== -1) {
        return indexA - indexB;
      }
      // If only one is in the predefined order, prioritize it
      if (indexA !== -1) return -1;
      if (indexB !== -1) return 1;
      // If neither is in the predefined order, sort alphabetically
      return a['BUSSINESS UNIT'].localeCompare(b['BUSSINESS UNIT']);
    });
    
    // Update S.No. after sorting
    const finalResult = sortedResult.map((item, index) => ({
      ...item,
      sNo: index + 1
    }));

    return { data: finalResult, allUniquePerspectiveValues: uniquePerspectiveValues };
  };

  const processTop10Data = () => {
    console.log('Processing Top 10 data...');
    
    // Find the PERSPECTIVE column specifically
    const perspectiveColumn = Object.keys(uploadedData[0]).find(key => 
      key.toLowerCase().includes('perspective')
    );
    
    if (!perspectiveColumn) {
      console.log('No perspective column found');
      return { data: [], allUniquePerspectiveValues: [] };
    }

    console.log('Perspective column found:', perspectiveColumn);

    // Get unique perspective values
    const uniquePerspectiveValues = [...new Set(uploadedData.map(row => row[perspectiveColumn]).filter(Boolean))];
    console.log('Unique perspective values:', uniquePerspectiveValues);

    // Group by customer ID
    const customerGroups = {};
    
    uploadedData.forEach(row => {
      const customerId = row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || row['CUST_ID'] || 'Unknown';
      const customerName = row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || row['CUST_NM'] || 'N/A';
      const businessUnit = row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || row['Business Unit'] || 'N/A';
      
      if (!customerGroups[customerId]) {
        customerGroups[customerId] = {
          customerId,
          customerName,
          businessUnit,
          cssSentCount: 0,
          cssReceivedCount: 0,
          nonStaffingCount: 0,
          staffingCount: 0
        };
        
        // Initialize perspective counts
        uniquePerspectiveValues.forEach(pv => {
          customerGroups[customerId][pv] = 0;
        });
      }

      // Count ratings 4 or 5 for each perspective
      const rating = parseFloat(row['RATING']) || 0;
      if (rating >= 4) {
        const perspective = row[perspectiveColumn];
        if (perspective && customerGroups[customerId][perspective] !== undefined) {
          customerGroups[customerId][perspective]++;
        }
      }
    });

    // Get CSS counts from second sheet and filter by Top 10
    if (excelData && excelData.secondSheetData && Array.isArray(excelData.secondSheetData)) {
      const customerCSSCounts = {};
      const customerNonStaffingCounts = {};
      const customerStaffingCounts = {};
      const top10Customers = new Set();

      // First, identify customers with Top 10 = "Y"
      excelData.secondSheetData.forEach(row => {
        const customerId = row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || row['CUST_ID'];
        const top10Value = row['Top 10'];
        
        if (customerId && top10Value === 'Y') {
          top10Customers.add(customerId);
        }
      });

      console.log('Top 10 customers from second sheet:', Array.from(top10Customers));

      // Process CSS counts for all customers (Top 10 and Others)
      excelData.secondSheetData.forEach(row => {
        const customerId = row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || row['CUST_ID'];
        const cssSentDate = row['CSS_SENT_DATE'];
        const cssReceivedDate = row['CSS_RECEIVED_DATE'];
        const revenueType = row['REVENUE_TYPE'];

        if (customerId) {
          if (!customerCSSCounts[customerId]) {
            customerCSSCounts[customerId] = { sent: 0, received: 0 };
            customerNonStaffingCounts[customerId] = 0;
            customerStaffingCounts[customerId] = 0;
          }

          if (cssSentDate && isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart(cssSentDate)) {
            customerCSSCounts[customerId].sent++;
          }
          if (cssReceivedDate && isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart(cssReceivedDate)) {
            customerCSSCounts[customerId].received++;
            
            if (revenueType && ['Time and Material', 'Fixed Bid', 'Managed Services'].includes(revenueType)) {
              customerNonStaffingCounts[customerId]++;
            } else if (revenueType === 'Fixed Monthly') {
              customerStaffingCounts[customerId]++;
            }
          }
        }
      });

      // Filter customer groups to only include Top 10 customers
      const filteredCustomerGroups = {};
      const otherAccountGroup = {
        customerId: 'OTHER',
        customerName: 'Other Account',
        businessUnit: 'N/A',
        cssSentCount: 0,
        cssReceivedCount: 0,

        otherAccountGroup[pv] = 0;
      });

          customerGroups[customerId].cssReceivedCount = cssCounts.received;
          customerGroups[customerId].nonStaffingCount = customerNonStaffingCounts[customerId] || 0;
          customerGroups[customerId].staffingCount = customerStaffingCounts[customerId] || 0;

        } else {
          // This is not a Top 10 customer, add to Other Account
          const cssCounts = customerCSSCounts[customerId] || { sent: 0, received: 0 };
          otherAccountGroup.cssSentCount += cssCounts.sent;
          otherAccountGroup.cssReceivedCount += cssCounts.received;
          otherAccountGroup.nonStaffingCount += customerNonStaffingCounts[customerId] || 0;
          otherAccountGroup.staffingCount += customerStaffingCounts[customerId] || 0;

            otherAccountGroup[pv] += customerGroups[customerId][pv] || 0;
          });
        }
      });

      Object.keys(customerGroups).forEach(key => delete customerGroups[key]);
      Object.assign(customerGroups, filteredCustomerGroups);

      console.log('otherAccountGroup before adding:', otherAccountGroup);
      console.log('otherAccountGroup.cssSentCount:', otherAccountGroup.cssSentCount);
      console.log('otherAccountGroup.cssReceivedCount:', otherAccountGroup.cssReceivedCount);
      console.log('otherAccountGroup.nonStaffingCount:', otherAccountGroup.nonStaffingCount);
      console.log('otherAccountGroup.staffingCount:', otherAccountGroup.staffingCount);

      console.log('Other Account data added:', otherAccountGroup);
      console.log('=== END OTHER ACCOUNT DEBUG ===');
    }

    // Convert to array, filter out rows with 0 CSS surveys sent, and sort by total percentage (average of all perspective percentages)
    console.log('=== RESULT FILTERING DEBUG ===');
    console.log('customerGroups before filtering:', Object.keys(customerGroups));
    console.log('customerGroups values:', Object.values(customerGroups).map(obj => ({
      customerId: obj.customerId,
      customerName: obj.customerName,
      cssSentCount: obj.cssSentCount
    })));
    
    const result = Object.values(customerGroups)
      .filter(obj => {

          console.log(`Other Account: cssSentCount=${obj.cssSentCount}, included=true (always included)`);
          return true;
        }
        // For Top 10 customers, only include if they have CSS surveys sent
        const hasData = obj.cssSentCount > 0;
        console.log(`Customer ${obj.customerName} (${obj.customerId}): cssSentCount=${obj.cssSentCount}, included=${hasData}`);
        return hasData;
      }) // Filter out rows with 0 CSS surveys sent (except Other Account)
      .map((obj, index) => {
        const row = {
          sNo: index + 1,
          customerId: obj.customerId,
          customerName: obj.customerName,
          businessUnit: obj.businessUnit,
          cssSentCount: obj.cssSentCount,
          cssReceivedCount: obj.cssReceivedCount,
          nonStaffingCount: obj.nonStaffingCount,
          staffingCount: obj.staffingCount
        };

      uniquePerspectiveValues.forEach(pv => {

        const nonStaffingCount = obj.nonStaffingCount || 0;
        const totalReceivedCount = obj.cssReceivedCount || 0;
        const staffingCount = obj.staffingCount || 0;
        
        // Calculate percentage based on perspective type
        if (['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership'].includes(pv)) {
          // Use non-staffing surveys as denominator
          if (nonStaffingCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / nonStaffingCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else if (['Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment'].includes(pv)) {
          // Use total surveys received as denominator
          if (totalReceivedCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / totalReceivedCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else if (pv === 'Resource Competency') {
          // Use staffing surveys as denominator
          if (staffingCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / staffingCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else {
          // Show raw count for other perspectives
          row[pv] = count;
        }
      });

      return row;
    });

    // Sort by average percentage to identify top 10, with Other Account at the end
    const sortedResult = result.sort((a, b) => {
      // Always put Other Account at the end
      if (a.customerId === 'OTHER') return 1;
      if (b.customerId === 'OTHER') return -1;
      
      const aPercentages = uniquePerspectiveValues
        .filter(pv => ['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership', 'Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment', 'Resource Competency'].includes(pv))
        .map(pv => parseFloat(a[pv]?.replace('%', '') || '0'));
      const bPercentages = uniquePerspectiveValues
        .filter(pv => ['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership', 'Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment', 'Resource Competency'].includes(pv))
        .map(pv => parseFloat(b[pv]?.replace('%', '') || '0'));
      
      const aAvg = aPercentages.length > 0 ? aPercentages.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p, 0) / aPercentages.length : 0;
      const bAvg = bPercentages.length > 0 ? bPercentages.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p, 0) / bPercentages.length : 0;
      
      return bAvg - aAvg; // Descending order
    });

    // Add Top 10 indicator to all records
    const resultWithTop10 = sortedResult.map((row, index) => ({
      ...row,

      top10: index < 10 ? 'Y' : 'N'

    console.log('Final result customer names:', resultWithTop10.map(row => row.customerName));
    console.log('Other Account in final result:', resultWithTop10.find(row => row.customerId === 'OTHER'));
    console.log('=== END FINAL RESULT DEBUG ===');

    return { data: resultWithTop10, allUniquePerspectiveValues: uniquePerspectiveValues };

  const processedData = useMemo(() => {

      if (top10Column) {

        }

          customerCSSCounts.set(customerId, { cssSentCount: 0, cssReceivedCount: 0 });

        }
        if (!customerStaffingCounts.has(customerId)) {

        }

            if (isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart(cssSentDate)) {
              customerCSSCounts.get(customerId).cssSentCount++;
            }

        }
        if (cssReceivedColumn && secondRow[cssReceivedColumn]) {
          const cssReceivedDate = secondRow[cssReceivedColumn];
          if (cssReceivedDate && cssReceivedDate !== '' && cssReceivedDate !== 'N/A' && cssReceivedDate !== null && cssReceivedDate !== undefined) {
            if (isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart(cssReceivedDate)) {
              customerCSSCounts.get(customerId).cssReceivedCount++;
              
              // Count staffing vs non-staffing based on REVENUE_TYPE
              const revenueType = revenueTypeColumn ? secondRow[revenueTypeColumn] : '';
              if (revenueType === 'Fixed Monthly') {
                customerStaffingCounts.set(customerId, customerStaffingCounts.get(customerId) + 1);
              } else if (['Time and Material', 'Fixed Bid', 'Managed Services'].includes(revenueType)) {
                customerNonStaffingCounts.set(customerId, customerNonStaffingCounts.get(customerId) + 1);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // Process first sheet data grouped by customer
    uploadedData.forEach(row => {

      const perspective = row[perspectiveColumn];
      const rating = row['RATING'];

      // Only process if customer is in Top 10 (when Top 10 column exists)
      if (top10Column && !top10Customers.has(customerId)) {
        return; // Skip this customer
      }

      if (!customerGroups[customerId]) {
        customerGroups[customerId] = {
          customerId,
          customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || row['CUST_NM'] || 'N/A',
          businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || row['Business Unit'] || 'N/A',
          ...perspectiveValues.reduce((acc, pv) => { acc[pv] = 0; return acc; }, {}),
          cssSentCount: 0,
          cssReceivedCount: 0
        };

      if (perspective && perspectiveValues.includes(perspective) && (rating === 4 || rating === 5)) {
        customerGroups[customerId][perspective]++;
      }
    });

    Object.values(customerGroups).forEach((customerData) => {

      const nonStaffingCount = customerNonStaffingCounts.get(customerId) || 0;
      const staffingCount = customerStaffingCounts.get(customerId) || 0;
      
      customerData.cssSentCount = cssCounts.cssSentCount;
      customerData.cssReceivedCount = cssCounts.cssReceivedCount;
      customerData.nonStaffingCount = nonStaffingCount;
      customerData.staffingCount = staffingCount;
    });

    const result = Object.values(customerGroups)
      .filter(obj => obj.cssSentCount > 0) // Filter out rows with 0 CSS surveys sent
      .map((obj, index) => {
