```javascript
const AccountLevelRatingDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData) {
      console.log('No excelData provided to AccountLevelRatingDashboard');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
      console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
      console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

      // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
      const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
        name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
      );

      if (!targetSheetName) {
        console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
        return { error: 'CSAT received Report sheet not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        return { error: 'No data found in the sheet' };
      }

      console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

      // Find the header row
      let headerRowIndex = -1;
      let headers = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (row && row.length > 0) {
          const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
            headerRowIndex = i;
            headers = row;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Header row not found');
        return { error: 'Header row not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
      console.log('Headers:', headers);

      // Find column indices
      const sNoIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
        h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('s no')
      );
      const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
        h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
      );
      const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
        h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
        h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id')
      );
      const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
        h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name')
      );

      console.log('Column indices:', {
        sNoIndex,
        businessUnitIndex,
        customerIdIndex,
        customerNameIndex
      });

      if (sNoIndex === -1 || businessUnitIndex === -1 || customerIdIndex === -1 || customerNameIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Required columns not found');
        return { error: 'Required columns not found in the sheet' };
      }

      // Extract data rows
      const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
      const processedRows = dataRows
        .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
        .map((row, index) => ({
          sNo: row[sNoIndex] || (index + 1),
          businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
          customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
          customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || ''
        }))
        .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName); // Filter out empty rows

      console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
      console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

      return {
        data: processedRows,
        headers: {
          sNo: headers[sNoIndex],
          businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
          customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
          customerName: headers[customerNameIndex]
        }
      };

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          ← Back to Upload
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.sNo || 'S No.'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'Business Unit'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'Customer ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'Customer Name'}</Th>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {processedData.data.map((row, index) => (
              <Tr key={index}>
                <SNoTd>{row.sNo}</SNoTd>
                <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
              </Tr>
            ))}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;
```

```javascript
  // Navigation history for back button functionality
  const [navigationHistory, setNavigationHistory] = useState(['home']);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState('home');

  // Filter data based on selected filters
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return csatData.filter(item => {
      const accountMatch = !selectedAccount || item.account === selectedAccount;
      const projectMatch = !selectedProject || item.project === selectedProject;
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };
  }, [filteredData, showExcelData, showGoldenStar, showScoreBased, showAvgRating, showSentiments, excelData]);

  const handleExcelDataUpload = (result) => {
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload called ===');
    console.log('result:', result);
    console.log('result type:', typeof result);
    console.log('result.data:', result?.data);
    console.log('result.data type:', typeof result?.data);
    console.log('isArray result.data:', Array.isArray(result?.data));
    
    // Handle both old format (data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName) and new format (result object)
    if (typeof result === 'object' && result.data) {
      // New format: result object with {data, headers, secondSheetData, fileName, etc.}
      console.log('Using new format - setting excelData to full result object');
      setExcelData(result);
      setExcelHeaders(result.headers);
      setExcelFileName(result.fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    } else {
      // Old format: individual parameters (for backward compatibility)
      console.log('Using old format - individual parameters');
      const [data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName] = arguments;
      setExcelData(data);
      setExcelHeaders(headers);
      setExcelFileName(fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    }
    setShowExcelData(true);
    setShowHomePage(false);
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload completed ===');
  };

  const navigateToPage = (pageName) => {
    setNavigationHistory(prev => [...prev, pageName]);
    setCurrentPage(pageName);
  };

  const goBack = () => {
    if (navigationHistory.length > 1) {
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);
      setShowExcelData(false);
      setShowGoldenStar(false);
      setShowScoreBased(false);
      setShowAvgRating(false);
      setShowSentiments(false);
      setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
      setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
      setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
      setShowLowScore(false);
      setShowTop10Accounts(false);
      setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
      setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
      setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective(false);
    }
  };

  const navigateToPreviousPage = (pageName) => {
    // Reset all page states
    setShowHomePage(false);
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(false);
    setShowScoreBased(false);
    setShowAvgRating(false);
    setShowSentiments(false);
    setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
    setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
    setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
    setShowLowScore(false);
    setShowTop10Accounts(false);
    setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
    setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
    
    // Set the previous page
    switch (pageName) {
      case 'home':
        setShowHomePage(true);
        break;
      case 'excelData':
        // Only show excelData page if we have valid data
        if (excelData && Array.isArray(excelData) && excelData.length > 0) {

                    onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                    uploadedData={excelData}
                    uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <ExcelDataTable 
                    data={excelData} 
                    headers={excelHeaders} 
                    onReload={reloadExcelData}
                    onSwitchToPerfect5Rater={switchToPerfect5Rater}
                    onSwitchToLowScore={() => {
                      setShowLowScore(false);
                      setShowExcelData(true);
                    }}
                    onSwitchToTop10Accounts={switchToTop10Accounts}
                    onSwitchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts={switchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts}
                    onSwitchToAccountWiseAvg={switchToAccountWiseAvg}
                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App; 
```

```javascript
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);

                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App;
```

```javascript
const App = () => {
  const [selectedAccount, setSelectedAccount] = useState('');
  const [selectedProject, setSelectedProject] = useState('');
  const [selectedBU, setSelectedBU] = useState('');
  const [excelData, setExcelData] = useState(null);
  const [excelHeaders, setExcelHeaders] = useState(null);
  const [excelFileName, setExcelFileName] = useState(null);
  const [showExcelData, setShowExcelData] = useState(false);
  const [showGoldenStar, setShowGoldenStar] = useState(false);
  const [showScoreBased, setShowScoreBased] = useState(false);
  const [showAvgRating, setShowAvgRating] = useState(false);
  const [showSentiments, setShowSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarScore, setShowGolden5StarScore] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarSentiments, setShowGolden5StarSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showPerfect5Rater, setShowPerfect5Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showLowScore, setShowLowScore] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10Accounts, setShowTop10Accounts] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10FiveRaterAccounts, setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseAvg, setShowAccountWiseAvg] = useState(false);
  const [showCSATSurvey, setShowCSATSurvey] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showBUWiseResponseRate, setShowBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater, setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showSentimentsFeedback, setShowSentimentsFeedback] = useState(false);
  const [showSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective, setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution, setShowAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution] = useState(false);
  const [showQualitativeAnalysis, setShowQualitativeAnalysis] = useState(false);
  const [qualitativeAnalysisData, setQualitativeAnalysisData] = useState(null);
  const [currentDashboard, setCurrentDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [showHomePage, setShowHomePage] = useState(true);
  const [showPCSATView, setShowPCSATView] = useState(false);
  const [showACSATView, setShowACSATView] = useState(false);
  const [showACSATUpload, setShowACSATUpload] = useState(false);
  const [acsatFileUploaded, setAcsatFileUploaded] = useState(false);
  const [acsatExcelData, setAcsatExcelData] = useState(null);
  const [showAccountLevelRating, setShowAccountLevelRating] = useState(false);
  
  // Get CSAT cycle start date from context
  const { csatCycleStartDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted, updateCSATCycleStartDate } = useCSATContext();
  
  // Local state for CSAT date input
  const [localCSATDate, setLocalCSATDate] = useState('');
  
  // Navigation history for back button functionality
  const [navigationHistory, setNavigationHistory] = useState(['home']);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState('home');

  // Filter data based on selected filters
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return csatData.filter(item => {
      const accountMatch = !selectedAccount || item.account === selectedAccount;
      const projectMatch = !selectedProject || item.project === selectedProject;
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };
  }, [filteredData, showExcelData, showGoldenStar, showScoreBased, showAvgRating, showSentiments, excelData]);

  const handleAccountChange = (account) => {
    setSelectedAccount(account);
  };

  const handleProjectChange = (project) => {
    setSelectedProject(project);
  };

  const handleBUChange = (bu) => {
    setSelectedBU(bu);
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    setSelectedAccount('');
    setSelectedProject('');
    setSelectedBU('');
  };

  const handleExcelDataUpload = (result) => {
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload called ===');
    console.log('result:', result);
    console.log('result type:', typeof result);
    console.log('result.data:', result?.data);
    console.log('result.data type:', typeof result?.data);
    console.log('isArray result.data:', Array.isArray(result?.data));
    
    // Handle both old format (data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName) and new format (result object)
    if (typeof result === 'object' && result.data) {
      // New format: result object with {data, headers, secondSheetData, fileName, etc.}
      console.log('Using new format - setting excelData to full result object');
      setExcelData(result);
      setExcelHeaders(result.headers);
      setExcelFileName(result.fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    } else {
      // Old format: individual parameters (for backward compatibility)
      console.log('Using old format - individual parameters');
      const [data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName] = arguments;
      setExcelData(data);
      setExcelHeaders(headers);
      setExcelFileName(fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    }
    setShowExcelData(true);
    setShowHomePage(false);
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload completed ===');
  };

  const handleCSATCycleStartDateChange = (date) => {
    setCsatCycleStartDate(date);
    // Also store the formatted date in MM-DD-YYYY format for global access
    const formattedDate = formatDateToMMDDYYYY(date);
    setCsatCycleStartDateFormatted(formattedDate);
    console.log('CSAT Cycle Start Date:', { raw: date, formatted: formattedDate });
  };

  const handleLocalCSATDateChange = (e) => {
    const date = e.target.value;
    setLocalCSATDate(date);
    
    // Automatically store the date when selected

  const navigateToPage = (pageName) => {
    setNavigationHistory(prev => [...prev, pageName]);
    setCurrentPage(pageName);
  };

  const goBack = () => {
    if (navigationHistory.length > 1) {
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);
      setShowExcelData(false);
      setShowGoldenStar(false);
      setShowScoreBased(false);
      setShowAvgRating(false);
      setShowSentiments(false);
      setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
      setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
      setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
      setShowLowScore(false);
      setShowTop10Accounts(false);
      setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
      setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
      setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective(false);
    }
  };

  const navigateToPreviousPage = (pageName) => {
    // Reset all page states
    setShowHomePage(false);
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(false);
    setShowScoreBased(false);
    setShowAvgRating(false);
    setShowSentiments(false);
    setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
    setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
    setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
    setShowLowScore(false);
    setShowTop10Accounts(false);
    setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
    setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
    
    // Set the previous page
    switch (pageName) {
      case 'home':
        setShowHomePage(true);
        break;
      case 'excelData':
        // Only show excelData page if we have valid data
        if (excelData && Array.isArray(excelData) && excelData.length > 0) {
          setShowExcelData(true);
        } else {
          // If no valid data, go back to home page
          setShowHomePage(true);
        }
        break;
      case 'accountWiseResponseRate':
        setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'buWiseResponseRate':
        setShowBUWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'golden5StarScore':
        setShowGolden5StarScore(true);
        break;
      case 'accountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater':
        setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(true);
        break;
      case 'sentiments':
        setShowSentiments(true);
        break;
      case 'sentimentsFeedback':
        setShowSentimentsFeedback(true);
        break;
      case 'csatSurvey':
        setShowCSATSurvey(true);
        break;
      case 'qualitativeAnalysis':
        setShowQualitativeAnalysis(true);
        break;
      default:
        setShowHomePage(true);
    }
  };

  const handleUploadCSATSurvey = () => {
    setShowHomePage(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(true);
    navigateToPage('csatSurvey');

          isArray: Array.isArray(data),

        });

        break;
      default:
```

```javascript
const App = () => {
  const [selectedAccount, setSelectedAccount] = useState('');
  const [selectedProject, setSelectedProject] = useState('');
  const [selectedBU, setSelectedBU] = useState('');
  const [excelData, setExcelData] = useState(null);
  const [excelHeaders, setExcelHeaders] = useState(null);
  const [excelFileName, setExcelFileName] = useState(null);
  const [showExcelData, setShowExcelData] = useState(false);
  const [showGoldenStar, setShowGoldenStar] = useState(false);
  const [showScoreBased, setShowScoreBased] = useState(false);
  const [showAvgRating, setShowAvgRating] = useState(false);
  const [showSentiments, setShowSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarScore, setShowGolden5StarScore] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarSentiments, setShowGolden5StarSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showPerfect5Rater, setShowPerfect5Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showLowScore, setShowLowScore] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10Accounts, setShowTop10Accounts] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10FiveRaterAccounts, setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseAvg, setShowAccountWiseAvg] = useState(false);
  const [showCSATSurvey, setShowCSATSurvey] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showBUWiseResponseRate, setShowBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater, setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showSentimentsFeedback, setShowSentimentsFeedback] = useState(false);
  const [showSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective, setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution, setShowAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution] = useState(false);
  const [showQualitativeAnalysis, setShowQualitativeAnalysis] = useState(false);
  const [qualitativeAnalysisData, setQualitativeAnalysisData] = useState(null);
  const [currentDashboard, setCurrentDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [showHomePage, setShowHomePage] = useState(true);
  const [showPCSATView, setShowPCSATView] = useState(false);
  const [showACSATView, setShowACSATView] = useState(false);
  const [showACSATUpload, setShowACSATUpload] = useState(false);
  const [acsatFileUploaded, setAcsatFileUploaded] = useState(false);
  const [acsatExcelData, setAcsatExcelData] = useState(null);
  const [showAccountLevelRating, setShowAccountLevelRating] = useState(false);
  
  // Get CSAT cycle start date from context
  const { csatCycleStartDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted, updateCSATCycleStartDate } = useCSATContext();
  
  // Local state for CSAT date input
  const [localCSATDate, setLocalCSATDate] = useState('');
  
  // Navigation history for back button functionality
  const [navigationHistory, setNavigationHistory] = useState(['home']);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState('home');

  // Filter data based on selected filters
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return csatData.filter(item => {
      const accountMatch = !selectedAccount || item.account === selectedAccount;
      const projectMatch = !selectedProject || item.project === selectedProject;
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };
  }, [filteredData, showExcelData, showGoldenStar, showScoreBased, showAvgRating, showSentiments, excelData]);

  const handleAccountChange = (account) => {
    setSelectedAccount(account);
  };

  const handleProjectChange = (project) => {
    setSelectedProject(project);
  };

  const handleBUChange = (bu) => {
    setSelectedBU(bu);
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    setSelectedAccount('');
    setSelectedProject('');
    setSelectedBU('');
  };

  const handleExcelDataUpload = (result) => {
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload called ===');
    console.log('result:', result);
    console.log('result type:', typeof result);
    console.log('result.data:', result?.data);
    console.log('result.data type:', typeof result?.data);
    console.log('isArray result.data:', Array.isArray(result?.data));
    
    // Handle both old format (data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName) and new format (result object)
    if (typeof result === 'object' && result.data) {
      // New format: result object with {data, headers, secondSheetData, fileName, etc.}
      console.log('Using new format - setting excelData to full result object');
      setExcelData(result);
      setExcelHeaders(result.headers);
      setExcelFileName(result.fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    } else {
      // Old format: individual parameters (for backward compatibility)
      console.log('Using old format - individual parameters');
      const [data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName] = arguments;
      setExcelData(data);
      setExcelHeaders(headers);
      setExcelFileName(fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    }
    setShowExcelData(true);
    setShowHomePage(false);
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload completed ===');
  };

  const handleCSATCycleStartDateChange = (date) => {
    setCsatCycleStartDate(date);
    // Also store the formatted date in MM-DD-YYYY format for global access
    const formattedDate = formatDateToMMDDYYYY(date);
    setCsatCycleStartDateFormatted(formattedDate);
    console.log('CSAT Cycle Start Date:', { raw: date, formatted: formattedDate });
  };

  const handleLocalCSATDateChange = (e) => {
    const date = e.target.value;
    setLocalCSATDate(date);
    
    // Automatically store the date when selected
    if (date) {
      const formattedDate = formatDateToMMDDYYYY(date);
      updateCSATCycleStartDate(date, formattedDate);

  };

                    }}
                    onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <CSATSurveyDashboard 
                    data={excelData}
                    onBack={() => {
                      setShowCSATSurvey(false);
                      setShowExcelData(true);
                    }}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            ) : showExcelData ? (
              <FileUpload 
                onDataUpload={handleExcelDataUpload} 
                onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                onBackToHome={() => {
                  setShowExcelData(false);
                  setShowHomePage(true);
                }}
                uploadedData={excelData}
                uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
              />
            ) : (
              <>
                {!excelData || !Array.isArray(excelData) || excelData.length === 0 ? (
                  <FileUpload 
                    onDataUpload={handleExcelDataUpload} 
                    onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                    uploadedData={excelData}
                    uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <ExcelDataTable 
                    data={excelData} 
                    headers={excelHeaders} 
                    onReload={reloadExcelData}
                    onSwitchToPerfect5Rater={switchToPerfect5Rater}
                    onSwitchToLowScore={() => {
                      setShowLowScore(false);
                      setShowExcelData(true);
                    }}
                    onSwitchToTop10Accounts={switchToTop10Accounts}
                    onSwitchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts={switchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts}
                    onSwitchToAccountWiseAvg={switchToAccountWiseAvg}
                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App; 
```

```javascript
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;

  border: 1px solid #bae6fd;

  padding: 1rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-align: center;
  margin: 2rem 0;
`;

const AccountLevelRatingDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData) {
      console.log('No excelData provided to AccountLevelRatingDashboard');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
      console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
      console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

      // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
      const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
        name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
      );

      if (!targetSheetName) {
        console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
        return { error: 'CSAT received Report sheet not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        return { error: 'No data found in the sheet' };
      }

      console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

      // Find the header row
      let headerRowIndex = -1;
      let headers = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (row && row.length > 0) {
          const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
            headerRowIndex = i;
            headers = row;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Header row not found');
        return { error: 'Header row not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
      console.log('Headers:', headers);

      // Find column indices
      const sNoIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
        h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('s no')
      );
      const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
        h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
      );
      const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
        h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
        h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id')
      );
      const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
        h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name')
      );

      console.log('Column indices:', {
        sNoIndex,
        businessUnitIndex,
        customerIdIndex,
        customerNameIndex
      });

      if (sNoIndex === -1 || businessUnitIndex === -1 || customerIdIndex === -1 || customerNameIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Required columns not found');
        return { error: 'Required columns not found in the sheet' };
      }

      // Extract data rows
      const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
      const processedRows = dataRows
        .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
        .map((row, index) => ({
          sNo: row[sNoIndex] || (index + 1),
          businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
          customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
          customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || ''
        }))
        .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName); // Filter out empty rows

      console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
      console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

      return {
        data: processedRows,
        headers: {
          sNo: headers[sNoIndex],
          businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
          customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
          customerName: headers[customerNameIndex]
        }
      };

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          ← Back to Upload
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.sNo || 'S No.'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'Business Unit'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'Customer ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'Customer Name'}</Th>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {processedData.data.map((row, index) => (
              <Tr key={index}>
                <SNoTd>{row.sNo}</SNoTd>
                <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
              </Tr>
            ))}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;
```

```javascript
  border-radius: 8px;

function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  let processedData = null;
  let error = null;

  try {
    console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
    console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
    console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

    // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
    const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
      name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
      name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
      name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
    );

    if (!targetSheetName) {
      console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
      error = 'CSAT received Report sheet not found';
    } else {
      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        error = 'No data found in the sheet';
      } else {
        console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

        // Find the header row
        let headerRowIndex = -1;
        let headers = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
          const row = jsonData[i];
          if (row && row.length > 0) {
            const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
            if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
              headerRowIndex = i;
              headers = row;
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
          console.log('Header row not found');
          error = 'Header row not found';
        } else {
          console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
          console.log('Headers:', headers);

          // Find column indices
          const sNoIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
            h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('s no')
          );
          const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
            h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
          );
          const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
            h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
            h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id')
          );
          const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => 
            h && h.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name')
          );

          console.log('Column indices:', {
            sNoIndex,
            businessUnitIndex,
            customerIdIndex,
            customerNameIndex
          });

          if (sNoIndex === -1 || businessUnitIndex === -1 || customerIdIndex === -1 || customerNameIndex === -1) {
            console.log('Required columns not found');
            error = 'Required columns not found in the sheet';
          } else {
            // Extract data rows
            const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
            const processedRows = dataRows
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                sNo: row[sNoIndex] || (index + 1),
                businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
                customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
                customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName); // Filter out empty rows

            console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
            console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

            processedData = {
              data: processedRows,
              headers: {
                sNo: headers[sNoIndex],
                businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
                customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
                customerName: headers[customerNameIndex]
              }
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', err);
    error = 'Error processing data: ' + err.message;
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          ← Back to Upload
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.sNo || 'S No.'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'Business Unit'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'Customer ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'Customer Name'}</Th>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {processedData.data.map((row, index) => (
              <Tr key={index}>
                <SNoTd>{row.sNo}</SNoTd>
                <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
              </Tr>
            ))}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;
```

```javascript
          });
```

```javascript
            if (headers.length >= 4) {

                    customerId: row[2] || '',
                    customerName: row[3] || ''
                  }))
                  .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
                headers: {

                }

          } else {

            const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);

                customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
                customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || ''

                customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
                customerName: headers[customerNameIndex]
              }
            };
          }
        }
      }

  } catch (err) {

  if (error) {
```

## ✅ **Enhanced Column Detection:**

I've improved the dashboard to handle the "Required columns not found" error with several enhancements:

### **1. More Flexible Column Matching:**
- **S No.**: Now matches `s no`, `sno`, `serial`, `no`
- **Business Unit**: Now matches `business unit`, `businessunit`, `bu`, `unit`
- **Customer ID**: Now matches `customer_id`, `customer id`, `customerid`, `customer`, `id`
- **Customer Name**: Now matches `customer name`, `customername`, `name`, `client name`, `clientname`

### **2. Better Error Messages:**
- **Shows available columns** when specific ones aren't found
- **Lists missing columns** specifically
- **Shows available sheets** if the target sheet isn't found

### **3. Fallback Option:**
- **Uses first 4 columns** if the specific column names aren't found
- **Still displays data** even if column names don't match exactly

### **4. Enhanced Debugging:**
- **Console logs** show all available headers
- **Column indices** are logged for troubleshooting
- **Available sheets** are shown in error messages

## 🎯 **How to Debug:**

1. **Open browser console** (F12 → Console tab)
2. **Upload your Excel file** and click the dashboard button
3. **Check console logs** to see:
   - Available sheet names
   - Available column headers
   - Which columns were found/missing

## 🔍 **Common Issues & Solutions:**

### **If you see "CSAT received Report sheet not found":**
- Check the console to see available sheet names
- The sheet might be named differently (e.g., "CSAT Report", "Received Report", etc.)

### **If you see "Required columns not found":**
- Check the console to see available column headers
- The columns might be named differently (e.g., "Serial No." instead of "S No.")
- The fallback will use the first 4 columns if available

The dashboard should now be much more flexible and provide better error information to help identify what's in your Excel file!

```javascript
          // Check which columns are missing
          const missingColumns = [];
          if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
          if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
          if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');

          if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
            console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
            console.log('Available columns:', headers);
            
            // Try to use first 4 columns as fallback
            if (headers.length >= 4) {
              console.log('Using first 4 columns as fallback');
              processedData = {
                data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
                  .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
                  .map((row, index) => ({
                    sNo: row[0] || (index + 1),
                    businessUnit: row[1] || '',
                    customerId: row[2] || '',
                    customerName: row[3] || ''
                  }))
                  .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
                headers: {
                  sNo: headers[0] || 'Column 1',
                  businessUnit: headers[1] || 'Column 2',
                  customerId: headers[2] || 'Column 3',
                  customerName: headers[3] || 'Column 4'
                }
              };
            } else {
              error = `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}`;
            }
          } else {
            // Extract data rows
            const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
            const processedRows = dataRows
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                sNo: row[sNoIndex] || (index + 1),
                businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
                customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
                customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || ''
              }))

            processedData = {
              data: processedRows,
              headers: {
                sNo: headers[sNoIndex],
                businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
                customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
                customerName: headers[customerNameIndex]
              }
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', err);
    error = 'Error processing data: ' + err.message;
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>

          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          ← Back to Upload
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.sNo || 'S No.'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'Business Unit'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'Customer ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'Customer Name'}</Th>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {processedData.data.map((row, index) => (
              <Tr key={index}>

                <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
              </Tr>
            ))}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}
```

```javascript
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          ← Back to Upload
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.sNo || 'S No.'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'Business Unit'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'Customer ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'Customer Name'}</Th>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {processedData.data.map((row, index) => (
              <Tr key={index}>
                <SNoTd>{row.sNo}</SNoTd>
                <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
              </Tr>
            ))}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;
```

```javascript
        for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {

            if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {

            return str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit') || str.includes('bussiness unit') || 
                   str.includes('bu') || str.includes('unit');

              processedData = {

                    customerId: row[1] || '',
                    customerName: row[2] || ''
                  }))

                headers: {

              headers: {
                businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
                customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
                customerName: headers[customerNameIndex]
              }
            };

        }

  if (error) {

  );
}
```

```javascript
`;

`;

  color: #1f2937;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
`;

const BackButton = styled.button`
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7 0%, #9333ea 100%);
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;

  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;

  align-items: center;

  &:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);

const TableContainer = styled.div`
  background: white;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;

`;

  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
`;

const TableHeader = styled.thead`

`;

  color: white;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;

  white-space: nowrap;
`;

  background: white;
`;

  &:hover {
    background: #f9fafb;
  }
  
  &:last-child {

`;

  padding: 1rem;

  font-size: 0.875rem;

`;

  border: 1px solid #bae6fd;

  padding: 1rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-align: center;
  margin: 2rem 0;
`;

function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  let processedData = null;
  let error = null;

  try {
    console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
    console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
    console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

    // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
    const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
      name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
      name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
      name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
    );

    if (!targetSheetName) {
      console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
      error = `CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets: ${excelData.SheetNames.join(', ')}`;
    } else {
      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        error = 'No data found in the sheet';
      } else {
        console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

        // Find the header row
        let headerRowIndex = -1;
        let headers = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
          const row = jsonData[i];
          if (row && row.length > 0) {
            const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
            if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
              headerRowIndex = i;
              headers = row;
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
          console.log('Header row not found');
          error = 'Header row not found';
        } else {
          console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
          console.log('Headers:', headers);

          // Find column indices for the 3 required columns
          const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
            const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
            return str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit') || str.includes('bussiness unit') || 
```
```javascript
                   str.includes('bu head') || str.includes('buhead') || str.includes('bu') || str.includes('unit') ||
                   str.includes('head');
          });
          
          const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
            const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
            return str.includes('customer_id') || str.includes('customer id') || str.includes('customerid') || 
                   str.includes('customer') || str.includes('id');
          });
          
          const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
            const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
            return str.includes('customer name') || str.includes('customername') || str.includes('name') || 
                   str.includes('client name') || str.includes('clientname');
          });

          console.log('Available headers:', headers);
          console.log('Column indices found:', {
            businessUnitIndex,
            customerIdIndex,
            customerNameIndex
          });

          // Check which columns are missing
          const missingColumns = [];
          if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
          if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
          if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');

          if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
            console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
            console.log('Available columns:', headers);
            
            // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
            if (headers.length >= 3) {
              console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
              processedData = {
                data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
                  .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
                  .map((row, index) => ({
                    businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                    customerId: row[1] || '',
                    customerName: row[2] || ''
                  }))
                  .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
                headers: {
                  businessUnit: headers[0] || 'Column 1',
                  customerId: headers[1] || 'Column 2',
                  customerName: headers[2] || 'Column 3'
                }
              };
            } else {
              error = `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}`;
            }
          } else {
            // Extract data rows
            const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
            const processedRows = dataRows
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
                customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
                customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName); // Filter out empty rows

            console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
            console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

            processedData = {
              data: processedRows,
              headers: {
                businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
                customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
                customerName: headers[customerNameIndex]
              }
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', err);
    error = 'Error processing data: ' + err.message;
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          ← Back to Upload
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {processedData.data.map((row, index) => (
              <Tr key={index}>
                <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
              </Tr>
            ))}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;
```

```javascript
  color: #0369a1;
  padding: 1rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-align: center;
  margin: 2rem 0;
`;

function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  let processedData = null;
  let error = null;

  try {
    console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
    console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
    console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

    // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
    const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
      name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
      name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
      name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
    );

    if (!targetSheetName) {
      console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
      error = `CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets: ${excelData.SheetNames.join(', ')}`;
    } else {
      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        error = 'No data found in the sheet';
      } else {
        console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

        // Find the header row
        let headerRowIndex = -1;
        let headers = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
          const row = jsonData[i];
          if (row && row.length > 0) {
            const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
            if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
              headerRowIndex = i;
              headers = row;
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
          console.log('Header row not found');
          error = 'Header row not found';
        } else {
          console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
          console.log('Headers:', headers);

          // Find column indices for the 3 required columns
          const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
            const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
            return str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit') || str.includes('bussiness unit') || 
                   str.includes('bu head') || str.includes('buhead') || str.includes('bu') || str.includes('unit') ||
                   str.includes('head');
          });
          
          const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
            const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
            return str.includes('customer_id') || str.includes('customer id') || str.includes('customerid') || 
                   str.includes('customer') || str.includes('id');
          });
          
          const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
            const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
            return str.includes('customer name') || str.includes('customername') || str.includes('name') || 
                   str.includes('client name') || str.includes('clientname');
          });

          console.log('Available headers:', headers);
          console.log('Column indices found:', {
            businessUnitIndex,
            customerIdIndex,
            customerNameIndex
          });

          // Check which columns are missing
          const missingColumns = [];
          if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT/BU HEAD');
          if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
          if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');

          if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
            console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
            console.log('Available columns:', headers);
            
            // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
            if (headers.length >= 3) {
              console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
              processedData = {
                data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
                  .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
                  .map((row, index) => ({
                    businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                    customerId: row[1] || '',
                    customerName: row[2] || ''
                  }))
                  .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
                headers: {
                  businessUnit: headers[0] || 'Column 1',
                  customerId: headers[1] || 'Column 2',
                  customerName: headers[2] || 'Column 3'
                }
              };
            } else {
              error = `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}`;
            }
          } else {
            // Extract data rows
            const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
            const processedRows = dataRows
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
                customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
                customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName); // Filter out empty rows

            console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
            console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

            processedData = {
              data: processedRows,
              headers: {
                businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
                customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
                customerName: headers[customerNameIndex]
              }
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', err);
    error = 'Error processing data: ' + err.message;
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            ← Back to Upload
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          ← Back to Upload
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
```
```javascript
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BU HEAD'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {processedData.data.map((row, index) => (
              <Tr key={index}>
                <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
              </Tr>
            ))}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;
```

```javascript
        error = 'No data found in the sheet';
      } else {
        console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

        // Find the header row
        let headerRowIndex = -1;
        let headers = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
          const row = jsonData[i];
          if (row && row.length > 0) {
            const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
            if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
              headerRowIndex = i;
              headers = row;
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
          console.log('Header row not found');
          error = 'Header row not found';
        } else {
          console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
          console.log('Headers:', headers);

          // Find column indices for the 3 required columns
          const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
            const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
            return str.includes('bussiness unit') || str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit');
          });
          
          const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
            const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
            return str.includes('customer_id') || str.includes('customer id') || str.includes('customerid') || 
                   str.includes('customer') || str.includes('id');
          });
          
          const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
            const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
            return str.includes('customer name') || str.includes('customername') || str.includes('name') || 
                   str.includes('client name') || str.includes('clientname');
          });

          console.log('Available headers:', headers);
          console.log('Column indices found:', {
            businessUnitIndex,
            customerIdIndex,
            customerNameIndex
          });

          // Check which columns are missing
          const missingColumns = [];
          if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
          if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
          if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');

          if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
            console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
            console.log('Available columns:', headers);
            
            // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
            if (headers.length >= 3) {
              console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
              processedData = {
                data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
                  .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
                  .map((row, index) => ({
                    businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                    customerId: row[1] || '',
                    customerName: row[2] || ''
                  }))
                  .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
                headers: {
                  businessUnit: headers[0] || 'Column 1',
                  customerId: headers[1] || 'Column 2',
                  customerName: headers[2] || 'Column 3'
                }
              };
            } else {
              error = `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}`;
            }
          } else {

              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
                customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
                customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || ''
              }))

            console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

            processedData = {
              data: processedRows,
              headers: {
                businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
                customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
                customerName: headers[customerNameIndex]
              }
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', err);
    error = 'Error processing data: ' + err.message;
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>

          </BackButton>
```
