function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  // Process Excel data
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData) {
      console.log('No excelData provided to AccountLevelRatingDashboard');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
      console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
      console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

      // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
      const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
        name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
      );

      if (!targetSheetName) {
        console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
        return { error: `CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets: ${excelData.SheetNames.join(', ')}` };
      }

      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        return { error: 'No data found in the sheet' };
      }

      console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

      // Find the header row
      let headerRowIndex = -1;
      let headers = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (row && row.length > 0) {
          const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
            headerRowIndex = i;
            headers = row;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Header row not found');
        return { error: 'Header row not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
      console.log('Headers:', headers);

      // Find column indices for the required columns
      const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('bussiness unit') || str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit');
      });
      
      const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer_id') || str.includes('customer id') || str.includes('customerid') || 
               str.includes('customer') || str.includes('id');
      });
      
      const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer name') || str.includes('customername') || str.includes('name') || 
               str.includes('client name') || str.includes('clientname');
      });

      // Find perspective and rating columns
      const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('perspective') || str.includes('perspectives');
      });
      
      const ratingIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('rating') || str.includes('score') || str.includes('rate');
      });

      console.log('Available headers:', headers);
      console.log('Column indices found:', {
        businessUnitIndex,
        customerIdIndex,
        customerNameIndex,
        perspectiveIndex,
        ratingIndex
      });

      // Check which columns are missing
      const missingColumns = [];
      if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
      if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
      if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');
      if (perspectiveIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('PERSPECTIVE');
      if (ratingIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('RATING');

      if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
        console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
        console.log('Available columns:', headers);
        
        // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
        if (headers.length >= 3) {
          console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
          return {
            data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                customerId: row[1] || '',
                customerName: row[2] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
            headers: {
              businessUnit: headers[0] || 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
              customerId: headers[1] || 'CUSTOMER_ID',
              customerName: headers[2] || 'CUSTOMER NAME'
            }
          };
        } else {
          return { error: `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}` };
        }
      } else {
        // Extract data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
        const rawData = dataRows
          .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
          .map((row, index) => ({
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || '',
            perspective: row[perspectiveIndex] || '',
            rating: row[ratingIndex] || ''
          }))
          .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName && row.perspective && row.rating); // Filter out empty rows

        console.log('Raw data count:', rawData.length);
        console.log('Sample raw data:', rawData.slice(0, 3));

        // Group by customer and calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const customerGroups = {};
        
        rawData.forEach(row => {
          const key = `${row.customerId}-${row.customerName}`;
          if (!customerGroups[key]) {
            customerGroups[key] = {
              businessUnit: row.businessUnit,
              customerId: row.customerId,
              customerName: row.customerName,
              perspectives: {}
            };
          }
          
          const perspective = row.perspective.trim();
          const rating = parseFloat(row.rating);
          
          if (!isNaN(rating)) {
            if (!customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective]) {
              customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective] = {
                ratings: [],
                count: 0
              };
            }
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].ratings.push(rating);
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].count++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const targetPerspectives = ['Delivery Commitment', 'Customer Engagement and Relationship', 'Partner adding value to Customer Business'];
        const processedRows = Object.values(customerGroups).map(customer => {
          const result = {
            businessUnit: customer.businessUnit,
            customerId: customer.customerId,
            customerName: customer.customerName
          };
          
          // Calculate average rating for each target perspective
          targetPerspectives.forEach(perspective => {
            const perspectiveData = customer.perspectives[perspective];
            if (perspectiveData && perspectiveData.ratings.length > 0) {
              const averageRating = perspectiveData.ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating, 0) / perspectiveData.ratings.length;
              result[perspective] = Math.round(averageRating * 100) / 100; // Round to 2 decimal places
            } else {
              result[perspective] = null; // No data for this perspective
            }
          });
          
          return result;
        });

        console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
        console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

        return {
          data: processedRows,
          headers: {
            businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
            customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
            customerName: headers[customerNameIndex],
            perspectives: targetPerspectives
          }
        };
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData?.data) return null;
    
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      return processedData.data;
    }
    
    return processedData.data.filter(row => 
      row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [processedData?.data, searchTerm]);

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          Back
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <SearchContainer>
        <SearchTitle>
          🔍 Search Customer Name
        </SearchTitle>
        <SearchInputContainer>
          <SearchInput
            type="text"
            placeholder="Type customer name to search..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            style={{ paddingRight: searchTerm ? '4rem' : '1rem' }}
          />
          {searchTerm && (
            <ClearButton
              onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
              title="Clear search"
            >
              ✕ Clear
            </ClearButton>
          )}
        </SearchInputContainer>
        <SearchResults>
          {filteredData ? (
            searchTerm.trim() ? (
              `Found ${filteredData.length} of ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            ) : (
              `Showing all ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            )
          ) : (
            'No data available'
          )}
        </SearchResults>
      </SearchContainer>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
              {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                <Th key={perspective}>{perspective}</Th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {filteredData && filteredData.length > 0 ? (
              filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <Tr key={index}>
                  <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                  <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                  <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
                  {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                    <Td key={perspective} style={{ 
                      textAlign: 'center', 
                      fontWeight: '600',
                      color: row[perspective] !== null ? '#059669' : '#6b7280'
                    }}>
                      {row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'}
                    </Td>
                  ))}
                </Tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Tr>
                <Td colSpan={3 + (processedData.headers.perspectives ? processedData.headers.perspectives.length : 0)} 
                     style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  {searchTerm.trim() ? 'No customers found matching your search' : 'No data available'}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            )}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;

`;

  &:focus {

function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  // Process Excel data
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData) {
      console.log('No excelData provided to AccountLevelRatingDashboard');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
      console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
      console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

      // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
      const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
        name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
      );

      if (!targetSheetName) {
        console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
        return { error: `CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets: ${excelData.SheetNames.join(', ')}` };
      }

      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        return { error: 'No data found in the sheet' };
      }

      console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

      // Find the header row
      let headerRowIndex = -1;
      let headers = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (row && row.length > 0) {
          const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
            headerRowIndex = i;
            headers = row;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Header row not found');
        return { error: 'Header row not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
      console.log('Headers:', headers);

      // Find column indices for the required columns
      const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('bussiness unit') || str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit');
      });
      
      const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer_id') || str.includes('customer id') || str.includes('customerid') || 
               str.includes('customer') || str.includes('id');
      });
      
      const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer name') || str.includes('customername') || str.includes('name') || 
               str.includes('client name') || str.includes('clientname');
      });

      // Find perspective and rating columns
      const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('perspective') || str.includes('perspectives');
      });
      
      const ratingIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('rating') || str.includes('score') || str.includes('rate');
      });

      console.log('Available headers:', headers);
      console.log('Column indices found:', {
        businessUnitIndex,
        customerIdIndex,
        customerNameIndex,
        perspectiveIndex,
        ratingIndex
      });

      // Check which columns are missing
      const missingColumns = [];
      if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
      if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
      if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');
      if (perspectiveIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('PERSPECTIVE');
      if (ratingIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('RATING');

      if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
        console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
        console.log('Available columns:', headers);
        
        // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
        if (headers.length >= 3) {
          console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
          return {
            data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                customerId: row[1] || '',
                customerName: row[2] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
            headers: {
              businessUnit: headers[0] || 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
              customerId: headers[1] || 'CUSTOMER_ID',
              customerName: headers[2] || 'CUSTOMER NAME'
            }
          };
        } else {
          return { error: `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}` };
        }
      } else {
        // Extract data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
        const rawData = dataRows
          .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
          .map((row, index) => ({
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || '',
            perspective: row[perspectiveIndex] || '',
            rating: row[ratingIndex] || ''
          }))
          .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName && row.perspective && row.rating); // Filter out empty rows

        console.log('Raw data count:', rawData.length);
        console.log('Sample raw data:', rawData.slice(0, 3));

        // Group by customer and calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const customerGroups = {};
        
        rawData.forEach(row => {
          const key = `${row.customerId}-${row.customerName}`;
          if (!customerGroups[key]) {
            customerGroups[key] = {
              businessUnit: row.businessUnit,
              customerId: row.customerId,
              customerName: row.customerName,
              perspectives: {}
            };
          }
          
          const perspective = row.perspective.trim();
          const rating = parseFloat(row.rating);
          
          if (!isNaN(rating)) {
            if (!customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective]) {
              customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective] = {
                ratings: [],
                count: 0
              };
            }
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].ratings.push(rating);
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].count++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const targetPerspectives = ['Delivery Commitment', 'Customer Engagement and Relationship', 'Partner adding value to Customer Business'];
        const processedRows = Object.values(customerGroups).map(customer => {
          const result = {
            businessUnit: customer.businessUnit,
            customerId: customer.customerId,
            customerName: customer.customerName
          };
          
          // Calculate average rating for each target perspective
          targetPerspectives.forEach(perspective => {
            const perspectiveData = customer.perspectives[perspective];
            if (perspectiveData && perspectiveData.ratings.length > 0) {
              const averageRating = perspectiveData.ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating, 0) / perspectiveData.ratings.length;
              result[perspective] = Math.round(averageRating * 100) / 100; // Round to 2 decimal places
            } else {
              result[perspective] = null; // No data for this perspective
            }
          });
          
          return result;
        });

        console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
        console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

        return {
          data: processedRows,
          headers: {
            businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
            customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
            customerName: headers[customerNameIndex],
            perspectives: targetPerspectives
          }
        };
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData?.data) return null;
    
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      return processedData.data;
    }
    
    return processedData.data.filter(row => 
      row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [processedData?.data, searchTerm]);

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          Back
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <SearchContainer>
        <SearchTitle>
          🔍 Search Customer Name
        </SearchTitle>
        <SearchInputContainer>
          <SearchInput
            type="text"
            placeholder="Type customer name to search..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            style={{ paddingRight: searchTerm ? '4rem' : '1rem' }}
          />
          {searchTerm && (
            <ClearButton
              onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
              title="Clear search"
            >
              ✕ Clear
            </ClearButton>
          )}
        </SearchInputContainer>
        <SearchResults>
          {filteredData ? (
            searchTerm.trim() ? (
              `Found ${filteredData.length} of ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            ) : (
              `Showing all ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            )
          ) : (
            'No data available'
          )}
        </SearchResults>
      </SearchContainer>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
              {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                <Th key={perspective}>{perspective}</Th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {filteredData && filteredData.length > 0 ? (
              filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <Tr key={index}>
                  <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                  <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                  <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
                  {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                    <Td key={perspective} style={{ 
                      textAlign: 'center', 
                      fontWeight: '600',
                      color: row[perspective] !== null ? '#059669' : '#6b7280'
                    }}>
                      {row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'}
                    </Td>
                  ))}
                </Tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Tr>
                <Td colSpan={3 + (processedData.headers.perspectives ? processedData.headers.perspectives.length : 0)} 
                     style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  {searchTerm.trim() ? 'No customers found matching your search' : 'No data available'}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            )}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;

Perfect! I've successfully added horizontal and vertical scroll bars to the dashboard table.

## ✅ **Scroll Bars Added to Dashboard Table:**

### **1. Vertical Scroll Bar:**
- **`overflow: auto`** - Enables scrolling when content exceeds container height
- **`max-height: 70vh`** - Limits table height to 70% of viewport height
- **Automatic scrolling** when table content is taller than the container

### **2. Horizontal Scroll Bar:**
- **`overflow: auto`** - Enables horizontal scrolling when content exceeds container width
- **`max-width: 100%`** - Ensures table doesn't exceed container width
- **`min-width: 800px`** on table - Ensures horizontal scroll when there are many columns

### **3. Responsive Design:**
- **Vertical scroll** appears when there are many rows
- **Horizontal scroll** appears when there are many columns (like the perspective columns)
- **Maintains table structure** while allowing navigation through large datasets

### **4. User Experience:**
- **Easy navigation** through large datasets
- **Preserved table headers** - headers remain visible while scrolling
- **Smooth scrolling** with native browser scroll behavior
- **Responsive layout** that works on different screen sizes

### **5. Benefits:**
- **Handles large datasets** without breaking the layout
- **Maintains readability** with proper column alignment
- **Professional appearance** with clean scroll bars
- **Better usability** for tables with many columns and rows

The dashboard table now has both horizontal and vertical scroll bars, making it easy to navigate through large datasets while maintaining a clean, professional appearance!

        customerNameIndex,
        perspectiveIndex,
        ratingIndex
      });

      // Check which columns are missing
      const missingColumns = [];
      if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
      if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
      if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');
      if (perspectiveIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('PERSPECTIVE');
      if (ratingIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('RATING');

      if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
        console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
        console.log('Available columns:', headers);
        
        // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
        if (headers.length >= 3) {
          console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
          return {
            data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                customerId: row[1] || '',
                customerName: row[2] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
            headers: {
              businessUnit: headers[0] || 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
              customerId: headers[1] || 'CUSTOMER_ID',
              customerName: headers[2] || 'CUSTOMER NAME'
            }
          };
        } else {
          return { error: `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}` };
        }
      } else {
        // Extract data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
        const rawData = dataRows
          .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
          .map((row, index) => ({
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || '',
            perspective: row[perspectiveIndex] || '',
            rating: row[ratingIndex] || ''
          }))
          .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName && row.perspective && row.rating); // Filter out empty rows

        console.log('Raw data count:', rawData.length);
        console.log('Sample raw data:', rawData.slice(0, 3));

        // Group by customer and calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const customerGroups = {};
        
        rawData.forEach(row => {
          const key = `${row.customerId}-${row.customerName}`;
          if (!customerGroups[key]) {
            customerGroups[key] = {
              businessUnit: row.businessUnit,
              customerId: row.customerId,
              customerName: row.customerName,
              perspectives: {}
            };
          }
          
          const perspective = row.perspective.trim();
          const rating = parseFloat(row.rating);
          
          if (!isNaN(rating)) {
            if (!customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective]) {
              customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective] = {
                ratings: [],
                count: 0
              };
            }
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].ratings.push(rating);
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].count++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const targetPerspectives = ['Delivery Commitment', 'Customer Engagement and Relationship', 'Partner adding value to Customer Business'];
        const processedRows = Object.values(customerGroups).map(customer => {
          const result = {
            businessUnit: customer.businessUnit,
            customerId: customer.customerId,
            customerName: customer.customerName
          };
          
          // Calculate average rating for each target perspective
          targetPerspectives.forEach(perspective => {
            const perspectiveData = customer.perspectives[perspective];
            if (perspectiveData && perspectiveData.ratings.length > 0) {
              const averageRating = perspectiveData.ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating, 0) / perspectiveData.ratings.length;
              result[perspective] = Math.round(averageRating * 100) / 100; // Round to 2 decimal places
            } else {
              result[perspective] = null; // No data for this perspective
            }
          });
          
          return result;
        });

        console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
        console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

        return {
          data: processedRows,
          headers: {
            businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
            customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
            customerName: headers[customerNameIndex],
            perspectives: targetPerspectives
          }
        };
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData?.data) return null;
    
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      return processedData.data;
    }
    
    return processedData.data.filter(row => 
      row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [processedData?.data, searchTerm]);

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          Back
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <SearchContainer>
        <SearchTitle>
          🔍 Search Customer Name
        </SearchTitle>
        <SearchInputContainer>
          <SearchInput
            type="text"
            placeholder="Type customer name to search..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            style={{ paddingRight: searchTerm ? '4rem' : '1rem' }}
          />
          {searchTerm && (
            <ClearButton
              onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
              title="Clear search"
            >
              ✕ Clear
            </ClearButton>
          )}
        </SearchInputContainer>
        <SearchResults>
          {filteredData ? (
            searchTerm.trim() ? (
              `Found ${filteredData.length} of ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            ) : (
              `Showing all ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            )
          ) : (
            'No data available'
          )}
        </SearchResults>
      </SearchContainer>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
              {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                <Th key={perspective}>{perspective}</Th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {filteredData && filteredData.length > 0 ? (
              filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <Tr key={index}>
                  <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                  <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                  <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
                  {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                    <Td key={perspective} style={{ 
                      textAlign: 'center', 
                      fontWeight: '600',
                      color: row[perspective] !== null ? '#059669' : '#6b7280'
                    }}>
                      {row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'}
                    </Td>
                  ))}
                </Tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Tr>
                <Td colSpan={3 + (processedData.headers.perspectives ? processedData.headers.perspectives.length : 0)} 
                     style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  {searchTerm.trim() ? 'No customers found matching your search' : 'No data available'}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            )}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;

          {filteredData ? (

              `Found ${filteredData.length} of ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            ) : (
              `Showing all ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            )
          ) : (
            'No data available'
          )}
        </SearchResults>
      </SearchContainer>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
              {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                <Th key={perspective}>{perspective}</Th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {filteredData && filteredData.length > 0 ? (
              filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <Tr key={index}>
                  <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                  <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                  <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
                  {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                    <Td key={perspective} style={{ 
                      textAlign: 'center', 
                      fontWeight: '600',
                      color: row[perspective] !== null ? '#059669' : '#6b7280'
                    }}>
                      {row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'}
                    </Td>
                  ))}
                </Tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Tr>
                <Td colSpan={3 + (processedData.headers.perspectives ? processedData.headers.perspectives.length : 0)} 
                     style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  {searchTerm.trim() ? 'No customers found matching your search' : 'No data available'}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            )}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;

function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  // Process Excel data
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData) {
      console.log('No excelData provided to AccountLevelRatingDashboard');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
      console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
      console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

      // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
      const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
        name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
      );

      if (!targetSheetName) {
        console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
        return { error: `CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets: ${excelData.SheetNames.join(', ')}` };
      }

      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        return { error: 'No data found in the sheet' };
      }

      console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

      // Find the header row
      let headerRowIndex = -1;
      let headers = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (row && row.length > 0) {
          const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
            headerRowIndex = i;
            headers = row;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Header row not found');
        return { error: 'Header row not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
      console.log('Headers:', headers);

      // Find column indices for the required columns
      const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('bussiness unit') || str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit');
      });
      
      const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer_id') || str.includes('customer id') || str.includes('customerid') || 
               str.includes('customer') || str.includes('id');
      });
      
      const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer name') || str.includes('customername') || str.includes('name') || 
               str.includes('client name') || str.includes('clientname');
      });

      // Find perspective and rating columns
      const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('perspective') || str.includes('perspectives');
      });
      
      const ratingIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('rating') || str.includes('score') || str.includes('rate');
      });

      console.log('Available headers:', headers);
      console.log('Column indices found:', {
        businessUnitIndex,
        customerIdIndex,
        customerNameIndex,
        perspectiveIndex,
        ratingIndex
      });

      // Check which columns are missing
      const missingColumns = [];
      if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
      if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
      if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');
      if (perspectiveIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('PERSPECTIVE');
      if (ratingIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('RATING');

      if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
        console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
        console.log('Available columns:', headers);
        
        // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
        if (headers.length >= 3) {
          console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
          return {
            data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                customerId: row[1] || '',
                customerName: row[2] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
            headers: {
              businessUnit: headers[0] || 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
              customerId: headers[1] || 'CUSTOMER_ID',
              customerName: headers[2] || 'CUSTOMER NAME'
            }
          };
        } else {
          return { error: `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}` };
        }
      } else {
        // Extract data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
        const rawData = dataRows
          .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
          .map((row, index) => ({
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || '',
            perspective: row[perspectiveIndex] || '',
            rating: row[ratingIndex] || ''
          }))
          .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName && row.perspective && row.rating); // Filter out empty rows

        console.log('Raw data count:', rawData.length);
        console.log('Sample raw data:', rawData.slice(0, 3));

        // Group by customer and calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const customerGroups = {};
        
        rawData.forEach(row => {
          const key = `${row.customerId}-${row.customerName}`;
          if (!customerGroups[key]) {
            customerGroups[key] = {
              businessUnit: row.businessUnit,
              customerId: row.customerId,
              customerName: row.customerName,
              perspectives: {}
            };
          }
          
          const perspective = row.perspective.trim();
          const rating = parseFloat(row.rating);
          
          if (!isNaN(rating)) {
            if (!customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective]) {
              customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective] = {
                ratings: [],
                count: 0
              };
            }
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].ratings.push(rating);
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].count++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const targetPerspectives = ['Delivery Commitment', 'Customer Engagement and Relationship', 'Partner adding value to Customer Business'];
        const processedRows = Object.values(customerGroups).map(customer => {
          const result = {
            businessUnit: customer.businessUnit,
            customerId: customer.customerId,
            customerName: customer.customerName
          };
          
          // Calculate average rating for each target perspective
          targetPerspectives.forEach(perspective => {
            const perspectiveData = customer.perspectives[perspective];
            if (perspectiveData && perspectiveData.ratings.length > 0) {
              const averageRating = perspectiveData.ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating, 0) / perspectiveData.ratings.length;
              result[perspective] = Math.round(averageRating * 100) / 100; // Round to 2 decimal places
            } else {
              result[perspective] = null; // No data for this perspective
            }
          });
          
          return result;
        });

        console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
        console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

        return {
          data: processedRows,
          headers: {
            businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
            customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
            customerName: headers[customerNameIndex],
            perspectives: targetPerspectives
          }
        };
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData?.data) return null;
    
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      return processedData.data;
    }
    
    return processedData.data.filter(row => 
      row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [processedData?.data, searchTerm]);

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          Back
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <SearchContainer>
        <SearchTitle>
          🔍 Search Customer Name
        </SearchTitle>
        <SearchInputContainer>
          <SearchInput
            type="text"
            placeholder="Type customer name to search..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            style={{ paddingRight: searchTerm ? '4rem' : '1rem' }}
          />
          {searchTerm && (
            <ClearButton
              onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
              title="Clear search"
            >
              ✕ Clear
            </ClearButton>
          )}
        </SearchInputContainer>
        <SearchResults>
          {filteredData ? (
            searchTerm.trim() ? (
              `Found ${filteredData.length} of ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            ) : (
              `Showing all ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            )
          ) : (
            'No data available'
          )}
        </SearchResults>
      </SearchContainer>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
              {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                <Th key={perspective}>{perspective}</Th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {filteredData && filteredData.length > 0 ? (
              filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <Tr key={index}>
                  <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                  <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                  <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
                  {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                    <Td key={perspective} style={{ 
                      textAlign: 'center', 
                      fontWeight: '600',
                      color: row[perspective] !== null ? '#059669' : '#6b7280'
                    }}>
                      {row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'}
                    </Td>
                  ))}
                </Tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Tr>
                <Td colSpan={3 + (processedData.headers.perspectives ? processedData.headers.perspectives.length : 0)} 
                     style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  {searchTerm.trim() ? 'No customers found matching your search' : 'No data available'}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            )}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;

## ✅ **Word Wrap Added for Header and Cell Text:**

### **1. Header Text Wrapping (Th component):**
- **`white-space: normal`** - Allows text to wrap to multiple lines
- **`word-wrap: break-word`** - Breaks long words when necessary
- **`overflow-wrap: break-word`** - Modern CSS property for word breaking
- **`line-height: 1.4`** - Improved readability with proper line spacing
- **`max-width: 250px`** - Limits column width to encourage wrapping
- **`min-width: 150px`** - Ensures minimum readable width

### **2. Cell Text Wrapping (Td component):**
- **`white-space: normal`** - Allows text to wrap to multiple lines
- **`word-wrap: break-word`** - Breaks long words when necessary
- **`overflow-wrap: break-word`** - Modern CSS property for word breaking
- **`line-height: 1.4`** - Improved readability with proper line spacing
- **`max-width: 250px`** - Limits column width to encourage wrapping
- **`min-width: 150px`** - Ensures minimum readable width

### **3. Benefits:**
- **Long perspective names** like "Customer Engagement and Relationship" will wrap properly
- **Long customer names** will wrap instead of being truncated
- **Better readability** with proper line spacing
- **Consistent column widths** with min/max constraints
- **Professional appearance** with clean text wrapping

### **4. Applied to All Columns:**
- **BUSSINESS UNIT** - Wraps long business unit names
- **CUSTOMER_ID** - Wraps if needed (though IDs are usually short)
- **CUSTOMER NAME** - Wraps long customer names
- **Perspective columns** - Wraps long perspective names like "Partner adding value to Customer Business"

The table now handles long text gracefully with proper word wrapping for both headers and cell content, making it much more readable and professional!

function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  // Process Excel data
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData) {
      console.log('No excelData provided to AccountLevelRatingDashboard');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
      console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
      console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

      // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
      const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
        name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
      );

      if (!targetSheetName) {
        console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
        return { error: `CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets: ${excelData.SheetNames.join(', ')}` };
      }

      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        return { error: 'No data found in the sheet' };
      }

      console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

      // Find the header row
      let headerRowIndex = -1;
      let headers = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (row && row.length > 0) {
          const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
            headerRowIndex = i;
            headers = row;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Header row not found');
        return { error: 'Header row not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
      console.log('Headers:', headers);

      // Find column indices for the required columns
      const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('bussiness unit') || str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit');
      });
      
      const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer_id') || str.includes('customer id') || str.includes('customerid') || 
               str.includes('customer') || str.includes('id');
      });
      
      const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer name') || str.includes('customername') || str.includes('name') || 
               str.includes('client name') || str.includes('clientname');
      });

      // Find perspective and rating columns
      const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('perspective') || str.includes('perspectives');
      });
      
      const ratingIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('rating') || str.includes('score') || str.includes('rate');
      });

      console.log('Available headers:', headers);
      console.log('Column indices found:', {
        businessUnitIndex,
        customerIdIndex,
        customerNameIndex,
        perspectiveIndex,
        ratingIndex
      });

      // Check which columns are missing
      const missingColumns = [];
      if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
      if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
      if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');
      if (perspectiveIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('PERSPECTIVE');
      if (ratingIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('RATING');

      if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
        console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
        console.log('Available columns:', headers);
        
        // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
        if (headers.length >= 3) {
          console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
          return {
            data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                customerId: row[1] || '',
                customerName: row[2] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
            headers: {
              businessUnit: headers[0] || 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
              customerId: headers[1] || 'CUSTOMER_ID',
              customerName: headers[2] || 'CUSTOMER NAME'
            }
          };
        } else {
          return { error: `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}` };
        }
      } else {
        // Extract data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
        const rawData = dataRows
          .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
          .map((row, index) => ({
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || '',
            perspective: row[perspectiveIndex] || '',
            rating: row[ratingIndex] || ''
          }))
          .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName && row.perspective && row.rating); // Filter out empty rows

        console.log('Raw data count:', rawData.length);
        console.log('Sample raw data:', rawData.slice(0, 3));

        // Group by customer and calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const customerGroups = {};
        
        rawData.forEach(row => {
          const key = `${row.customerId}-${row.customerName}`;
          if (!customerGroups[key]) {
            customerGroups[key] = {
              businessUnit: row.businessUnit,
              customerId: row.customerId,
              customerName: row.customerName,
              perspectives: {}
            };
          }
          
          const perspective = row.perspective.trim();
          const rating = parseFloat(row.rating);
          
          if (!isNaN(rating)) {
            if (!customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective]) {
              customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective] = {
                ratings: [],
                count: 0
              };
            }
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].ratings.push(rating);
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].count++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const targetPerspectives = ['Delivery Commitment', 'Customer Engagement and Relationship', 'Partner adding value to Customer Business'];
        const processedRows = Object.values(customerGroups).map(customer => {
          const result = {
            businessUnit: customer.businessUnit,
            customerId: customer.customerId,
            customerName: customer.customerName
          };
          
          // Calculate average rating for each target perspective
          targetPerspectives.forEach(perspective => {
            const perspectiveData = customer.perspectives[perspective];
            if (perspectiveData && perspectiveData.ratings.length > 0) {
              const averageRating = perspectiveData.ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating, 0) / perspectiveData.ratings.length;
              result[perspective] = Math.round(averageRating * 100) / 100; // Round to 2 decimal places
            } else {
              result[perspective] = null; // No data for this perspective
            }
          });
          
          return result;
        });

        console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
        console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

        return {
          data: processedRows,
          headers: {
            businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
            customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
            customerName: headers[customerNameIndex],
            perspectives: targetPerspectives
          }
        };
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData?.data) return null;
    
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      return processedData.data;
    }
    
    return processedData.data.filter(row => 
      row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [processedData?.data, searchTerm]);

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          Back
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <SearchContainer>
        <SearchTitle>
          🔍 Search Customer Name
        </SearchTitle>
        <SearchInputContainer>
          <SearchInput
            type="text"
            placeholder="Type customer name to search..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            style={{ paddingRight: searchTerm ? '4rem' : '1rem' }}
          />
          {searchTerm && (
            <ClearButton
              onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
              title="Clear search"
            >
              ✕ Clear
            </ClearButton>
          )}
        </SearchInputContainer>
        <SearchResults>
          {filteredData ? (
            searchTerm.trim() ? (
              `Found ${filteredData.length} of ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            ) : (
              `Showing all ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            )
          ) : (
            'No data available'
          )}
        </SearchResults>
      </SearchContainer>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
              {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                <Th key={perspective}>{perspective}</Th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {filteredData && filteredData.length > 0 ? (
              filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <Tr key={index}>
                  <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                  <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                  <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
                  {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                    <Td key={perspective} style={{ 
                      textAlign: 'center', 
                      fontWeight: '600',
                      color: row[perspective] !== null ? '#059669' : '#6b7280'
                    }}>
                      {row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'}
                    </Td>
                  ))}
                </Tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Tr>
                <Td colSpan={3 + (processedData.headers.perspectives ? processedData.headers.perspectives.length : 0)} 
                     style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  {searchTerm.trim() ? 'No customers found matching your search' : 'No data available'}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            )}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;

                customerName: row[2] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
            headers: {
              businessUnit: headers[0] || 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
              customerId: headers[1] || 'CUSTOMER_ID',
              customerName: headers[2] || 'CUSTOMER NAME'
            }
          };
        } else {
          return { error: `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}` };
        }
      } else {
        // Extract data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
        const rawData = dataRows
          .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
          .map((row, index) => ({
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || '',
            perspective: row[perspectiveIndex] || '',
            rating: row[ratingIndex] || ''
          }))
          .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName && row.perspective && row.rating); // Filter out empty rows

        console.log('Raw data count:', rawData.length);
        console.log('Sample raw data:', rawData.slice(0, 3));

        // Group by customer and calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const customerGroups = {};
        
        rawData.forEach(row => {
          const key = `${row.customerId}-${row.customerName}`;
          if (!customerGroups[key]) {
            customerGroups[key] = {
              businessUnit: row.businessUnit,
              customerId: row.customerId,
              customerName: row.customerName,
              perspectives: {}
            };
          }
          
          const perspective = row.perspective.trim();
          const rating = parseFloat(row.rating);
          
          if (!isNaN(rating)) {
            if (!customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective]) {
              customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective] = {
                ratings: [],
                count: 0
              };
            }
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].ratings.push(rating);
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].count++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const targetPerspectives = ['Delivery Commitment', 'Customer Engagement and Relationship', 'Partner adding value to Customer Business'];
        const processedRows = Object.values(customerGroups).map(customer => {
          const result = {
            businessUnit: customer.businessUnit,
            customerId: customer.customerId,
            customerName: customer.customerName
          };
          
          // Calculate average rating for each target perspective
          targetPerspectives.forEach(perspective => {
            const perspectiveData = customer.perspectives[perspective];
            if (perspectiveData && perspectiveData.ratings.length > 0) {
              const averageRating = perspectiveData.ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating, 0) / perspectiveData.ratings.length;
              result[perspective] = Math.round(averageRating * 100) / 100; // Round to 2 decimal places
            } else {
              result[perspective] = null; // No data for this perspective
            }
          });
          
          return result;
        });

        console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
        console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

        return {
          data: processedRows,
          headers: {
            businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
            customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
            customerName: headers[customerNameIndex],
            perspectives: targetPerspectives
          }
        };
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData?.data) return null;
    
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      return processedData.data;
    }
    
    return processedData.data.filter(row => 
      row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [processedData?.data, searchTerm]);

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
          Back
        </BackButton>
      </Header>

      <SearchContainer>
        <SearchTitle>
          🔍 Search Customer Name
        </SearchTitle>
        <SearchInputContainer>
          <SearchInput
            type="text"
            placeholder="Type customer name to search..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            style={{ paddingRight: searchTerm ? '4rem' : '1rem' }}
          />
          {searchTerm && (
            <ClearButton
              onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
              title="Clear search"
            >
              ✕ Clear
            </ClearButton>
          )}
        </SearchInputContainer>
        <SearchResults>
          {filteredData ? (
            searchTerm.trim() ? (
              `Found ${filteredData.length} of ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            ) : (
              `Showing all ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            )
          ) : (
            'No data available'
          )}
        </SearchResults>
      </SearchContainer>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
              {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                <Th key={perspective}>{perspective}</Th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {filteredData && filteredData.length > 0 ? (
              filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <Tr key={index}>
                  <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                  <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                  <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
                  {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                    <Td key={perspective} style={{ 
                      textAlign: 'center', 
                      fontWeight: '600',
                      color: row[perspective] !== null ? '#059669' : '#6b7280'
                    }}>
                      {row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'}
                    </Td>
                  ))}
                </Tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Tr>
                <Td colSpan={3 + (processedData.headers.perspectives ? processedData.headers.perspectives.length : 0)} 
                     style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  {searchTerm.trim() ? 'No customers found matching your search' : 'No data available'}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            )}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;
