```javascript
function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  // Process Excel data
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData) {
      console.log('No excelData provided to AccountLevelRatingDashboard');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
      console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
      console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

      // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
      const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
        name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
      );

      if (!targetSheetName) {
        console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
        return { error: `CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets: ${excelData.SheetNames.join(', ')}` };
      }

      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        return { error: 'No data found in the sheet' };
      }

      console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

      // Find the header row
      let headerRowIndex = -1;
      let headers = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (row && row.length > 0) {
          const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
            headerRowIndex = i;
            headers = row;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Header row not found');
        return { error: 'Header row not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
      console.log('Headers:', headers);

      // Find column indices for the required columns
      const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('bussiness unit') || str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit');
      });
      
      const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer_id') || str.includes('customer id') || str.includes('customerid') || 
               str.includes('customer') || str.includes('id');
      });
      
      const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer name') || str.includes('customername') || str.includes('name') || 
               str.includes('client name') || str.includes('clientname');
      });

      // Find perspective and rating columns
      const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('perspective') || str.includes('perspectives');
      });
      
      const ratingIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('rating') || str.includes('score') || str.includes('rate');
      });

      console.log('Available headers:', headers);
      console.log('Column indices found:', {
        businessUnitIndex,
        customerIdIndex,
        customerNameIndex,
        perspectiveIndex,
        ratingIndex
      });

      // Check which columns are missing
      const missingColumns = [];
      if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
      if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
      if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');
      if (perspectiveIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('PERSPECTIVE');
      if (ratingIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('RATING');

      if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
        console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
        console.log('Available columns:', headers);
        
        // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
        if (headers.length >= 3) {
          console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
          return {
            data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                customerId: row[1] || '',
                customerName: row[2] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
            headers: {
              businessUnit: headers[0] || 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
              customerId: headers[1] || 'CUSTOMER_ID',
              customerName: headers[2] || 'CUSTOMER NAME'
            }
          };
        } else {
          return { error: `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}` };
        }
      } else {
        // Extract data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
        const rawData = dataRows
          .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
          .map((row, index) => ({
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || '',
            perspective: row[perspectiveIndex] || '',
            rating: row[ratingIndex] || ''
          }))
          .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName && row.perspective && row.rating); // Filter out empty rows

        console.log('Raw data count:', rawData.length);
        console.log('Sample raw data:', rawData.slice(0, 3));

        // Group by customer and calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const customerGroups = {};
        
        rawData.forEach(row => {
          const key = `${row.customerId}-${row.customerName}`;
          if (!customerGroups[key]) {
            customerGroups[key] = {
              businessUnit: row.businessUnit,
              customerId: row.customerId,
              customerName: row.customerName,
              perspectives: {}
            };
          }
          
          const perspective = row.perspective.trim();
          const rating = parseFloat(row.rating);
          
          if (!isNaN(rating)) {
            if (!customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective]) {
              customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective] = {
                ratings: [],
                count: 0
              };
            }
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].ratings.push(rating);
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].count++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const targetPerspectives = ['Delivery Commitment', 'Customer Engagement and Relationship', 'Partner adding value to Customer Business'];
        const processedRows = Object.values(customerGroups).map(customer => {
          const result = {
            businessUnit: customer.businessUnit,
            customerId: customer.customerId,
            customerName: customer.customerName
          };
          
          // Calculate average rating for each target perspective
          targetPerspectives.forEach(perspective => {
            const perspectiveData = customer.perspectives[perspective];
            if (perspectiveData && perspectiveData.ratings.length > 0) {
              const averageRating = perspectiveData.ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating, 0) / perspectiveData.ratings.length;
              result[perspective] = Math.round(averageRating * 100) / 100; // Round to 2 decimal places
            } else {
              result[perspective] = null; // No data for this perspective
            }
          });
          
          return result;
        });

        console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
        console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

        return {
          data: processedRows,
          headers: {
            businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
            customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
            customerName: headers[customerNameIndex],
            perspectives: targetPerspectives
          }
        };
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData?.data) return null;
    
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      return processedData.data;
    }
    
    return processedData.data.filter(row => 
      row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [processedData?.data, searchTerm]);

  // Download CSV function
  const downloadCSV = () => {
    if (!filteredData || filteredData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data available to download');
      return;
    }

    // Prepare headers
    const headers = [
      'Business Unit',
      'Customer ID', 
      'Customer Name',
      ...(processedData.headers.perspectives || [])
    ];

    // Prepare data rows
    const csvData = filteredData.map(row => [
      row.businessUnit || '',
      row.customerId || '',
      row.customerName || '',
      ...(processedData.headers.perspectives || []).map(perspective => 
        row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'
      )
    ]);

    // Create CSV content
    const csvContent = [
      headers.join(','),
      ...csvData.map(row => row.map(cell => `"${cell}"`).join(','))
    ].join('\n');

    // Create and download file
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.setAttribute('href', url);
    link.setAttribute('download', `Account_Level_Rating_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`);
    link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadCSV}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download CSV
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </Header>

      <SearchContainer>
        <SearchTitle>
          🔍 Search Customer Name
        </SearchTitle>
        <SearchInputContainer>
          <SearchInput
            type="text"
            placeholder="Type customer name to search..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            style={{ paddingRight: searchTerm ? '4rem' : '1rem' }}
          />
          {searchTerm && (
            <ClearButton
              onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
              title="Clear search"
            >
              ✕ Clear
            </ClearButton>
          )}
        </SearchInputContainer>
        <SearchResults>
          {filteredData ? (
            searchTerm.trim() ? (
              `Found ${filteredData.length} of ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            ) : (
              `Showing all ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            )
          ) : (
            'No data available'
          )}
        </SearchResults>
      </SearchContainer>

      <LegendContainer>
        <LegendTitle>
          🎨 Rating Color Legend
        </LegendTitle>
        <LegendGrid>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#fef2f2', borderColor: '#dc2626' }} />
            <LegendText>&lt; 4.0 (Dark Red)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#fef3c7', borderColor: '#d97706' }} />
            <LegendText>4.0 - 4.49 (Dark Amber)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#d1fae5', borderColor: '#059669' }} />
            <LegendText>4.5 - 4.99 (Light Green)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#bbf7d0', borderColor: '#047857' }} />
            <LegendText>= 5.0 (Dark Green)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
        </LegendGrid>
      </LegendContainer>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
              {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                <Th key={perspective}>{perspective}</Th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {filteredData && filteredData.length > 0 ? (
              filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <Tr key={index}>
                  <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                  <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                  <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
                  {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                    <Td key={perspective} style={{ 
                      textAlign: 'center', 
                      fontWeight: '600',
                      color: row[perspective] !== null ? '#059669' : '#6b7280'
                    }}>
                      {row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'}
                    </Td>
                  ))}
                </Tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Tr>
                <Td colSpan={3 + (processedData.headers.perspectives ? processedData.headers.perspectives.length : 0)} 
                     style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  {searchTerm.trim() ? 'No customers found matching your search' : 'No data available'}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            )}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;
```

```javascript
function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  // Process Excel data
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData) {
      console.log('No excelData provided to AccountLevelRatingDashboard');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
      console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
      console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

      // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
      const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
        name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
      );

      if (!targetSheetName) {
        console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
        return { error: `CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets: ${excelData.SheetNames.join(', ')}` };
      }

      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        return { error: 'No data found in the sheet' };
      }

      console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

      // Find the header row
      let headerRowIndex = -1;
      let headers = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (row && row.length > 0) {
          const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
            headerRowIndex = i;
            headers = row;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Header row not found');
        return { error: 'Header row not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
      console.log('Headers:', headers);

      // Find column indices for the required columns
      const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('bussiness unit') || str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit');
      });
      
      const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer_id') || str.includes('customer id') || str.includes('customerid') || 
               str.includes('customer') || str.includes('id');
      });
      
      const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer name') || str.includes('customername') || str.includes('name') || 
               str.includes('client name') || str.includes('clientname');
      });

      // Find perspective and rating columns
      const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('perspective') || str.includes('perspectives');
      });
      
      const ratingIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('rating') || str.includes('score') || str.includes('rate');
      });

      console.log('Available headers:', headers);
      console.log('Column indices found:', {
        businessUnitIndex,
        customerIdIndex,
        customerNameIndex,
        perspectiveIndex,
        ratingIndex
      });

      // Check which columns are missing
      const missingColumns = [];
      if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
      if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
      if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');
      if (perspectiveIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('PERSPECTIVE');
      if (ratingIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('RATING');

      if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
        console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
        console.log('Available columns:', headers);
        
        // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
        if (headers.length >= 3) {
          console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
          return {
            data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                customerId: row[1] || '',
                customerName: row[2] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
            headers: {
              businessUnit: headers[0] || 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
              customerId: headers[1] || 'CUSTOMER_ID',
              customerName: headers[2] || 'CUSTOMER NAME'
            }
          };
        } else {
          return { error: `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}` };
        }
      } else {
        // Extract data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
        const rawData = dataRows
          .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
          .map((row, index) => ({
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || '',
            perspective: row[perspectiveIndex] || '',
            rating: row[ratingIndex] || ''
          }))
          .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName && row.perspective && row.rating); // Filter out empty rows

        console.log('Raw data count:', rawData.length);
        console.log('Sample raw data:', rawData.slice(0, 3));

        // Group by customer and calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const customerGroups = {};
        
        rawData.forEach(row => {
          const key = `${row.customerId}-${row.customerName}`;
          if (!customerGroups[key]) {
            customerGroups[key] = {
              businessUnit: row.businessUnit,
              customerId: row.customerId,
              customerName: row.customerName,
              perspectives: {}
            };
          }
          
          const perspective = row.perspective.trim();
          const rating = parseFloat(row.rating);
          
          if (!isNaN(rating)) {
            if (!customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective]) {
              customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective] = {
                ratings: [],
                count: 0
              };
            }
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].ratings.push(rating);
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].count++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const targetPerspectives = ['Delivery Commitment', 'Customer Engagement and Relationship', 'Partner adding value to Customer Business'];
        const processedRows = Object.values(customerGroups).map(customer => {
          const result = {
            businessUnit: customer.businessUnit,
            customerId: customer.customerId,
            customerName: customer.customerName
          };
          
          // Calculate average rating for each target perspective
          targetPerspectives.forEach(perspective => {
            const perspectiveData = customer.perspectives[perspective];
            if (perspectiveData && perspectiveData.ratings.length > 0) {
              const averageRating = perspectiveData.ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating, 0) / perspectiveData.ratings.length;
              result[perspective] = Math.round(averageRating * 100) / 100; // Round to 2 decimal places
            } else {
              result[perspective] = null; // No data for this perspective
            }
          });
          
          return result;
        });

        console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
        console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

        return {
          data: processedRows,
          headers: {
            businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
            customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
            customerName: headers[customerNameIndex],
            perspectives: targetPerspectives
          }
        };
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData?.data) return null;
    
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      return processedData.data;
    }
    
    return processedData.data.filter(row => 
      row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [processedData?.data, searchTerm]);

  // Download CSV function
  const downloadCSV = () => {
    if (!filteredData || filteredData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data available to download');
      return;
    }

    // Prepare headers
    const headers = [
      'Business Unit',
      'Customer ID', 
      'Customer Name',
      ...(processedData.headers.perspectives || [])
    ];

    // Prepare data rows
    const csvData = filteredData.map(row => [
      row.businessUnit || '',
      row.customerId || '',
      row.customerName || '',
      ...(processedData.headers.perspectives || []).map(perspective => 
        row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'
      )
    ]);

    // Create CSV content
    const csvContent = [
      headers.join(','),
      ...csvData.map(row => row.map(cell => `"${cell}"`).join(','))
    ].join('\n');

    // Create and download file
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.setAttribute('href', url);
    link.setAttribute('download', `Account_Level_Rating_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`);
    link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadCSV}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download CSV
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </Header>

      <SearchContainer>
        <SearchTitle>
          🔍 Search Customer Name
        </SearchTitle>
        <SearchInputContainer>
          <SearchInput
            type="text"
            placeholder="Type customer name to search..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            style={{ paddingRight: searchTerm ? '4rem' : '1rem' }}
          />
          {searchTerm && (
            <ClearButton
              onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
              title="Clear search"
            >
              ✕ Clear
            </ClearButton>
          )}
        </SearchInputContainer>
        <SearchResults>
          {filteredData ? (
            searchTerm.trim() ? (
              `Found ${filteredData.length} of ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            ) : (
              `Showing all ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            )
          ) : (
            'No data available'
          )}
        </SearchResults>
      </SearchContainer>

      <LegendContainer>
        <LegendTitle>
          🎨 Rating Color Legend
        </LegendTitle>
        <LegendGrid>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#fef2f2', borderColor: '#dc2626' }} />
            <LegendText>&lt; 4.0 (Dark Red)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#fef3c7', borderColor: '#d97706' }} />
            <LegendText>4.0 - 4.49 (Dark Amber)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#d1fae5', borderColor: '#059669' }} />
            <LegendText>4.5 - 4.99 (Light Green)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#bbf7d0', borderColor: '#047857' }} />
            <LegendText>= 5.0 (Dark Green)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
        </LegendGrid>
      </LegendContainer>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
              {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                <Th key={perspective}>{perspective}</Th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {filteredData && filteredData.length > 0 ? (
              filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <Tr key={index}>
                  <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                  <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                  <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
                  {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                    <RatingCell key={perspective} rating={row[perspective]}>
                      {row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'}
                    </RatingCell>
                  ))}
                </Tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Tr>
                <Td colSpan={3 + (processedData.headers.perspectives ? processedData.headers.perspectives.length : 0)} 
                     style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  {searchTerm.trim() ? 'No customers found matching your search' : 'No data available'}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            )}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;
```

```javascript
    return '#6b7280';
  }};

function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  // Process Excel data
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData) {
      console.log('No excelData provided to AccountLevelRatingDashboard');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
      console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
      console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

      // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
      const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
        name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
      );

      if (!targetSheetName) {
        console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
        return { error: `CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets: ${excelData.SheetNames.join(', ')}` };
      }

      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        return { error: 'No data found in the sheet' };
      }

      console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

      // Find the header row
      let headerRowIndex = -1;
      let headers = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (row && row.length > 0) {
          const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
            headerRowIndex = i;
            headers = row;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Header row not found');
        return { error: 'Header row not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
      console.log('Headers:', headers);

      // Find column indices for the required columns
      const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('bussiness unit') || str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit');
      });
      
      const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer_id') || str.includes('customer id') || str.includes('customerid') || 
               str.includes('customer') || str.includes('id');
      });
      
      const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer name') || str.includes('customername') || str.includes('name') || 
               str.includes('client name') || str.includes('clientname');
      });

      // Find perspective and rating columns
      const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('perspective') || str.includes('perspectives');
      });
      
      const ratingIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('rating') || str.includes('score') || str.includes('rate');
      });

      console.log('Available headers:', headers);
      console.log('Column indices found:', {
        businessUnitIndex,
        customerIdIndex,
        customerNameIndex,
        perspectiveIndex,
        ratingIndex
      });

      // Check which columns are missing
      const missingColumns = [];
      if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
      if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
      if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');
      if (perspectiveIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('PERSPECTIVE');
      if (ratingIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('RATING');

      if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
        console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
        console.log('Available columns:', headers);
        
        // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
        if (headers.length >= 3) {
          console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
          return {
            data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                customerId: row[1] || '',
                customerName: row[2] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
            headers: {
              businessUnit: headers[0] || 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
              customerId: headers[1] || 'CUSTOMER_ID',
              customerName: headers[2] || 'CUSTOMER NAME'
            }
          };
        } else {
          return { error: `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}` };
        }
      } else {
        // Extract data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
        const rawData = dataRows
          .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
          .map((row, index) => ({
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || '',
            perspective: row[perspectiveIndex] || '',
            rating: row[ratingIndex] || ''
          }))
          .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName && row.perspective && row.rating); // Filter out empty rows

        console.log('Raw data count:', rawData.length);
        console.log('Sample raw data:', rawData.slice(0, 3));

        // Group by customer and calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const customerGroups = {};
        
        rawData.forEach(row => {
          const key = `${row.customerId}-${row.customerName}`;
          if (!customerGroups[key]) {
            customerGroups[key] = {
              businessUnit: row.businessUnit,
              customerId: row.customerId,
              customerName: row.customerName,
              perspectives: {}
            };
          }
          
          const perspective = row.perspective.trim();
          const rating = parseFloat(row.rating);
          
          if (!isNaN(rating)) {
            if (!customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective]) {
              customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective] = {
                ratings: [],
                count: 0
              };
            }
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].ratings.push(rating);
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].count++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const targetPerspectives = ['Delivery Commitment', 'Customer Engagement and Relationship', 'Partner adding value to Customer Business'];
        const processedRows = Object.values(customerGroups).map(customer => {
          const result = {
            businessUnit: customer.businessUnit,
            customerId: customer.customerId,
            customerName: customer.customerName
          };
          
          // Calculate average rating for each target perspective
          targetPerspectives.forEach(perspective => {
            const perspectiveData = customer.perspectives[perspective];
            if (perspectiveData && perspectiveData.ratings.length > 0) {
              const averageRating = perspectiveData.ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating, 0) / perspectiveData.ratings.length;
              result[perspective] = Math.round(averageRating * 100) / 100; // Round to 2 decimal places
            } else {
              result[perspective] = null; // No data for this perspective
            }
          });
          
          return result;
        });

        console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
        console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

        return {
          data: processedRows,
          headers: {
            businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
            customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
            customerName: headers[customerNameIndex],
            perspectives: targetPerspectives
          }
        };
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData?.data) return null;
    
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      return processedData.data;
    }
    
    return processedData.data.filter(row => 
      row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [processedData?.data, searchTerm]);

  // Helper function to get color based on rating
  const getRatingColor = (rating) => {
    if (rating === null || rating === undefined) return { bg: '#f3f4f6', text: '#6b7280' };
    if (rating < 4) return { bg: '#fef2f2', text: '#dc2626' };
    if (rating >= 4 && rating < 4.5) return { bg: '#fef3c7', text: '#d97706' };
    if (rating >= 4.5 && rating < 5) return { bg: '#d1fae5', text: '#059669' };
    if (rating === 5) return { bg: '#bbf7d0', text: '#047857' };
    return { bg: '#f3f4f6', text: '#6b7280' };
  };

  // Download Excel function with color coding
  const downloadExcel = () => {
    if (!filteredData || filteredData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data available to download');
      return;
    }

    // Prepare headers
    const headers = [
      'Business Unit',
      'Customer ID', 
      'Customer Name',
      ...(processedData.headers.perspectives || [])
    ];

    // Prepare data rows
    const dataRows = filteredData.map(row => [
      row.businessUnit || '',
      row.customerId || '',
      row.customerName || '',
      ...(processedData.headers.perspectives || []).map(perspective => 
        row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'
      )
    ]);

    // Create worksheet data
    const wsData = [headers, ...dataRows];

    // Create workbook
    const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
    const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(wsData);

    // Add color coding to rating columns
    const ratingColumns = processedData.headers.perspectives || [];
    const ratingColumnIndices = ratingColumns.map((_, index) => 3 + index); // Starting from column 3 (0-based)

    // Apply formatting to each cell
    const range = XLSX.utils.decode_range(ws['!ref']);
    
    // Style the header row
    for (let col = range.s.c; col <= range.e.c; col++) {
      const cellAddress = XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ r: 0, c: col });
      if (!ws[cellAddress]) ws[cellAddress] = { v: '' };
      ws[cellAddress].s = {
        font: { bold: true, color: { rgb: 'FFFFFF' } },
        fill: { fgColor: { rgb: '1D4ED8' } },
        alignment: { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'center' },
        border: {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: '000000' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: '000000' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: '000000' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: '000000' } }
        }
      };
    }

    // Style data rows with color coding
    for (let row = 1; row <= dataRows.length; row++) {
      for (let col = range.s.c; col <= range.e.c; col++) {
        const cellAddress = XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ r: row, c: col });
        if (!ws[cellAddress]) ws[cellAddress] = { v: '' };
        
        const cellValue = ws[cellAddress].v;
        let cellStyle = {
          alignment: { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'center' },
          border: {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: 'E5E7EB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: 'E5E7EB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: 'E5E7EB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: 'E5E7EB' } }
          }
        };

        // Apply color coding to rating columns
        if (ratingColumnIndices.includes(col) && cellValue !== 'N/A' && !isNaN(cellValue)) {
          const rating = parseFloat(cellValue);
          const colors = getRatingColor(rating);
          
          // Convert hex colors to RGB
          const hexToRgb = (hex) => {
            const result = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex);
            return result ? {
              r: parseInt(result[1], 16),
              g: parseInt(result[2], 16),
              b: parseInt(result[3], 16)
            } : null;
          };

          const bgRgb = hexToRgb(colors.bg);
          const textRgb = hexToRgb(colors.text);

          if (bgRgb && textRgb) {
            cellStyle.fill = {
              fgColor: { rgb: `${bgRgb.r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${bgRgb.g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${bgRgb.b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`.toUpperCase() }
            };
            cellStyle.font = { 
              bold: true,
              color: { rgb: `${textRgb.r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${textRgb.g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${textRgb.b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`.toUpperCase() }
            };
          }
        } else if (ratingColumnIndices.includes(col) && cellValue === 'N/A') {
          cellStyle.fill = { fgColor: { rgb: 'F3F4F6' } };
          cellStyle.font = { color: { rgb: '6B7280' } };
        }

        ws[cellAddress].s = cellStyle;
      }
    }

    // Set column widths
    const colWidths = [
      { wch: 20 }, // Business Unit
      { wch: 15 }, // Customer ID
      { wch: 25 }, // Customer Name
      ...ratingColumns.map(() => ({ wch: 15 })) // Rating columns
    ];
    ws['!cols'] = colWidths;

    // Add legend sheet
    const legendData = [
      ['Rating Color Legend'],
      [''],
      ['Rating Range', 'Color', 'Description'],
      ['< 4.0', '', 'Dark Red'],
      ['4.0 - 4.49', '', 'Dark Amber'],
      ['4.5 - 4.99', '', 'Light Green'],
      ['= 5.0', '', 'Dark Green'],
      ['N/A', '', 'No Data Available']
    ];

    const legendWs = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(legendData);
    
    // Style legend sheet
    legendWs['A1'].s = {
      font: { bold: true, size: 14 },
      alignment: { horizontal: 'center' }
    };
    
    legendWs['A3'].s = { font: { bold: true } };
    legendWs['B3'].s = { font: { bold: true } };
    legendWs['C3'].s = { font: { bold: true } };

    // Add color coding to legend
    const legendColors = [
      { bg: '#fef2f2', text: '#dc2626' },
      { bg: '#fef3c7', text: '#d97706' },
      { bg: '#d1fae5', text: '#059669' },
      { bg: '#bbf7d0', text: '#047857' },
      { bg: '#f3f4f6', text: '#6b7280' }
    ];

    for (let i = 0; i < legendColors.length; i++) {
      const cellAddress = XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ r: 3 + i, c: 1 });
      if (!legendWs[cellAddress]) legendWs[cellAddress] = { v: '' };
      
      const colors = legendColors[i];
      const bgRgb = hexToRgb(colors.bg);
      const textRgb = hexToRgb(colors.text);
      
      if (bgRgb && textRgb) {
        legendWs[cellAddress].s = {
          fill: {
            fgColor: { rgb: `${bgRgb.r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${bgRgb.g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${bgRgb.b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`.toUpperCase() }
          },
          font: { 
            bold: true,
            color: { rgb: `${textRgb.r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${textRgb.g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${textRgb.b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`.toUpperCase() }
          },
          alignment: { horizontal: 'center' }
        };
      }
    }

    legendWs['!cols'] = [{ wch: 15 }, { wch: 10 }, { wch: 20 }];

    // Add sheets to workbook
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Account Level Ratings');
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, legendWs, 'Color Legend');

    // Generate and download file
    XLSX.writeFile(wb, `Account_Level_Rating_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`);
  };

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadCSV}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download CSV
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </Header>

      <SearchContainer>
        <SearchTitle>
          🔍 Search Customer Name
        </SearchTitle>
        <SearchInputContainer>
          <SearchInput
            type="text"
            placeholder="Type customer name to search..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            style={{ paddingRight: searchTerm ? '4rem' : '1rem' }}
          />
          {searchTerm && (
            <ClearButton
              onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
              title="Clear search"
            >
              ✕ Clear
            </ClearButton>
          )}
        </SearchInputContainer>
        <SearchResults>
          {filteredData ? (
            searchTerm.trim() ? (
              `Found ${filteredData.length} of ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            ) : (
              `Showing all ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            )
          ) : (
            'No data available'
          )}
        </SearchResults>
      </SearchContainer>

      <LegendContainer>
        <LegendTitle>
          🎨 Rating Color Legend
        </LegendTitle>
        <LegendGrid>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#fef2f2', borderColor: '#dc2626' }} />
            <LegendText>&lt; 4.0 (Dark Red)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#fef3c7', borderColor: '#d97706' }} />
            <LegendText>4.0 - 4.49 (Dark Amber)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#d1fae5', borderColor: '#059669' }} />
            <LegendText>4.5 - 4.99 (Light Green)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#bbf7d0', borderColor: '#047857' }} />
            <LegendText>= 5.0 (Dark Green)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
        </LegendGrid>
      </LegendContainer>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
              {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                <Th key={perspective}>{perspective}</Th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {filteredData && filteredData.length > 0 ? (
              filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <Tr key={index}>
                  <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                  <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                  <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
                  {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                    <RatingCell key={perspective} rating={row[perspective]}>
                      {row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'}
                    </RatingCell>
                  ))}
                </Tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Tr>
                <Td colSpan={3 + (processedData.headers.perspectives ? processedData.headers.perspectives.length : 0)} 
                     style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  {searchTerm.trim() ? 'No customers found matching your search' : 'No data available'}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            )}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;
```

```javascript
    return '#6b7280';
  }};

function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  // Process Excel data
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData) {
      console.log('No excelData provided to AccountLevelRatingDashboard');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      console.log('Processing ACSAT data for Account Level Rating Dashboard');
      console.log('Excel data:', excelData);
      console.log('Sheet names:', excelData.SheetNames);

      // Look for the "CSAT received Report" sheet
      const targetSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received report') || 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('csat received') ||
        name.toLowerCase().includes('received report')
      );

      if (!targetSheetName) {
        console.log('CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
        return { error: `CSAT received Report sheet not found. Available sheets: ${excelData.SheetNames.join(', ')}` };
      }

      console.log('Found target sheet:', targetSheetName);

      const sheet = excelData.Sheets[targetSheetName];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });

      if (!jsonData || jsonData.length === 0) {
        console.log('No data found in the sheet');
        return { error: 'No data found in the sheet' };
      }

      console.log('Raw sheet data (first 5 rows):', jsonData.slice(0, 5));

      // Find the header row
      let headerRowIndex = -1;
      let headers = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (row && row.length > 0) {
          const rowStr = row.join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if (rowStr.includes('s no') || rowStr.includes('business unit') || rowStr.includes('customer')) {
            headerRowIndex = i;
            headers = row;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
        console.log('Header row not found');
        return { error: 'Header row not found' };
      }

      console.log('Found header row at index:', headerRowIndex);
      console.log('Headers:', headers);

      // Find column indices for the required columns
      const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('bussiness unit') || str.includes('business unit') || str.includes('businessunit');
      });
      
      const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer_id') || str.includes('customer id') || str.includes('customerid') || 
               str.includes('customer') || str.includes('id');
      });
      
      const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('customer name') || str.includes('customername') || str.includes('name') || 
               str.includes('client name') || str.includes('clientname');
      });

      // Find perspective and rating columns
      const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('perspective') || str.includes('perspectives');
      });
      
      const ratingIndex = headers.findIndex(h => {
        const str = h ? h.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
        return str.includes('rating') || str.includes('score') || str.includes('rate');
      });

      console.log('Available headers:', headers);
      console.log('Column indices found:', {
        businessUnitIndex,
        customerIdIndex,
        customerNameIndex,
        perspectiveIndex,
        ratingIndex
      });

      // Check which columns are missing
      const missingColumns = [];
      if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSSINESS UNIT');
      if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID');
      if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME');
      if (perspectiveIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('PERSPECTIVE');
      if (ratingIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('RATING');

      if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
        console.log('Missing columns:', missingColumns);
        console.log('Available columns:', headers);
        
        // Try to use first 3 columns as fallback
        if (headers.length >= 3) {
          console.log('Using first 3 columns as fallback');
          return {
            data: jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1)
              .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
              .map((row, index) => ({
                businessUnit: row[0] || '',
                customerId: row[1] || '',
                customerName: row[2] || ''
              }))
              .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName),
            headers: {
              businessUnit: headers[0] || 'BUSSINESS UNIT',
              customerId: headers[1] || 'CUSTOMER_ID',
              customerName: headers[2] || 'CUSTOMER NAME'
            }
          };
        } else {
          return { error: `Required columns not found: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headers.join(', ')}` };
        }
      } else {
        // Extract data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1);
        const rawData = dataRows
          .filter(row => row && row.length > 0)
          .map((row, index) => ({
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerId: row[customerIdIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || '',
            perspective: row[perspectiveIndex] || '',
            rating: row[ratingIndex] || ''
          }))
          .filter(row => row.customerId && row.customerName && row.perspective && row.rating); // Filter out empty rows

        console.log('Raw data count:', rawData.length);
        console.log('Sample raw data:', rawData.slice(0, 3));

        // Group by customer and calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const customerGroups = {};
        
        rawData.forEach(row => {
          const key = `${row.customerId}-${row.customerName}`;
          if (!customerGroups[key]) {
            customerGroups[key] = {
              businessUnit: row.businessUnit,
              customerId: row.customerId,
              customerName: row.customerName,
              perspectives: {}
            };
          }
          
          const perspective = row.perspective.trim();
          const rating = parseFloat(row.rating);
          
          if (!isNaN(rating)) {
            if (!customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective]) {
              customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective] = {
                ratings: [],
                count: 0
              };
            }
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].ratings.push(rating);
            customerGroups[key].perspectives[perspective].count++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate average ratings for each perspective
        const targetPerspectives = ['Delivery Commitment', 'Customer Engagement and Relationship', 'Partner adding value to Customer Business'];
        const processedRows = Object.values(customerGroups).map(customer => {
          const result = {
            businessUnit: customer.businessUnit,
            customerId: customer.customerId,
            customerName: customer.customerName
          };
          
          // Calculate average rating for each target perspective
          targetPerspectives.forEach(perspective => {
            const perspectiveData = customer.perspectives[perspective];
            if (perspectiveData && perspectiveData.ratings.length > 0) {
              const averageRating = perspectiveData.ratings.reduce((sum, rating) => sum + rating, 0) / perspectiveData.ratings.length;
              result[perspective] = Math.round(averageRating * 100) / 100; // Round to 2 decimal places
            } else {
              result[perspective] = null; // No data for this perspective
            }
          });
          
          return result;
        });

        console.log('Processed rows count:', processedRows.length);
        console.log('Sample processed data:', processedRows.slice(0, 3));

        return {
          data: processedRows,
          headers: {
            businessUnit: headers[businessUnitIndex],
            customerId: headers[customerIdIndex],
            customerName: headers[customerNameIndex],
            perspectives: targetPerspectives
          }
        };
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing ACSAT data:', error);
      return { error: 'Error processing data: ' + error.message };
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData?.data) return null;
    
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      return processedData.data;
    }
    
    return processedData.data.filter(row => 
      row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [processedData?.data, searchTerm]);

  // Helper function to get color based on rating
  const getRatingColor = (rating) => {
    if (rating === null || rating === undefined) return { bg: '#f3f4f6', text: '#6b7280' };
    if (rating < 4) return { bg: '#fef2f2', text: '#dc2626' };
    if (rating >= 4 && rating < 4.5) return { bg: '#fef3c7', text: '#d97706' };
    if (rating >= 4.5 && rating < 5) return { bg: '#d1fae5', text: '#059669' };
    if (rating === 5) return { bg: '#bbf7d0', text: '#047857' };
    return { bg: '#f3f4f6', text: '#6b7280' };
  };

  // Download Excel function with color coding
  const downloadExcel = () => {
    if (!filteredData || filteredData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data available to download');
      return;
    }

    // Prepare headers
    const headers = [
      'Business Unit',
      'Customer ID', 
      'Customer Name',
      ...(processedData.headers.perspectives || [])
    ];

    // Prepare data rows
    const dataRows = filteredData.map(row => [
      row.businessUnit || '',
      row.customerId || '',
      row.customerName || '',
      ...(processedData.headers.perspectives || []).map(perspective => 
        row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'
      )
    ]);

    // Create worksheet data
    const wsData = [headers, ...dataRows];

    // Create workbook
    const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
    const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(wsData);

    // Add color coding to rating columns
    const ratingColumns = processedData.headers.perspectives || [];
    const ratingColumnIndices = ratingColumns.map((_, index) => 3 + index); // Starting from column 3 (0-based)

    // Apply formatting to each cell
    const range = XLSX.utils.decode_range(ws['!ref']);
    
    // Style the header row
    for (let col = range.s.c; col <= range.e.c; col++) {
      const cellAddress = XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ r: 0, c: col });
      if (!ws[cellAddress]) ws[cellAddress] = { v: '' };
      ws[cellAddress].s = {
        font: { bold: true, color: { rgb: 'FFFFFF' } },
        fill: { fgColor: { rgb: '1D4ED8' } },
        alignment: { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'center' },
        border: {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: '000000' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: '000000' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: '000000' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: '000000' } }
        }
      };
    }

    // Style data rows with color coding
    for (let row = 1; row <= dataRows.length; row++) {
      for (let col = range.s.c; col <= range.e.c; col++) {
        const cellAddress = XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ r: row, c: col });
        if (!ws[cellAddress]) ws[cellAddress] = { v: '' };
        
        const cellValue = ws[cellAddress].v;
        let cellStyle = {
          alignment: { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'center' },
          border: {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: 'E5E7EB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: 'E5E7EB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: 'E5E7EB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { rgb: 'E5E7EB' } }
          }
        };

        // Apply color coding to rating columns
        if (ratingColumnIndices.includes(col) && cellValue !== 'N/A' && !isNaN(cellValue)) {
          const rating = parseFloat(cellValue);
          const colors = getRatingColor(rating);
          
          // Convert hex colors to RGB
          const hexToRgb = (hex) => {
            const result = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex);
            return result ? {
              r: parseInt(result[1], 16),
              g: parseInt(result[2], 16),
              b: parseInt(result[3], 16)
            } : null;
          };

          const bgRgb = hexToRgb(colors.bg);
          const textRgb = hexToRgb(colors.text);

          if (bgRgb && textRgb) {
            cellStyle.fill = {
              fgColor: { rgb: `${bgRgb.r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${bgRgb.g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${bgRgb.b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`.toUpperCase() }
            };
            cellStyle.font = { 
              bold: true,
              color: { rgb: `${textRgb.r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${textRgb.g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${textRgb.b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`.toUpperCase() }
            };
          }
        } else if (ratingColumnIndices.includes(col) && cellValue === 'N/A') {
          cellStyle.fill = { fgColor: { rgb: 'F3F4F6' } };
          cellStyle.font = { color: { rgb: '6B7280' } };
        }

        ws[cellAddress].s = cellStyle;
      }
    }

    // Set column widths
    const colWidths = [
      { wch: 20 }, // Business Unit
      { wch: 15 }, // Customer ID
      { wch: 25 }, // Customer Name
      ...ratingColumns.map(() => ({ wch: 15 })) // Rating columns
    ];
    ws['!cols'] = colWidths;

    // Add legend sheet
    const legendData = [
      ['Rating Color Legend'],
      [''],
      ['Rating Range', 'Color', 'Description'],
      ['< 4.0', '', 'Dark Red'],
      ['4.0 - 4.49', '', 'Dark Amber'],
      ['4.5 - 4.99', '', 'Light Green'],
      ['= 5.0', '', 'Dark Green'],
      ['N/A', '', 'No Data Available']
    ];

    const legendWs = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(legendData);
    
    // Style legend sheet
    legendWs['A1'].s = {
      font: { bold: true, size: 14 },
      alignment: { horizontal: 'center' }
    };
    
    legendWs['A3'].s = { font: { bold: true } };
    legendWs['B3'].s = { font: { bold: true } };
    legendWs['C3'].s = { font: { bold: true } };

    // Add color coding to legend
    const legendColors = [
      { bg: '#fef2f2', text: '#dc2626' },
      { bg: '#fef3c7', text: '#d97706' },
      { bg: '#d1fae5', text: '#059669' },
      { bg: '#bbf7d0', text: '#047857' },
      { bg: '#f3f4f6', text: '#6b7280' }
    ];

    for (let i = 0; i < legendColors.length; i++) {
      const cellAddress = XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ r: 3 + i, c: 1 });
      if (!legendWs[cellAddress]) legendWs[cellAddress] = { v: '' };
      
      const colors = legendColors[i];
      const bgRgb = hexToRgb(colors.bg);
      const textRgb = hexToRgb(colors.text);
      
      if (bgRgb && textRgb) {
        legendWs[cellAddress].s = {
          fill: {
            fgColor: { rgb: `${bgRgb.r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${bgRgb.g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${bgRgb.b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`.toUpperCase() }
          },
          font: { 
            bold: true,
            color: { rgb: `${textRgb.r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${textRgb.g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${textRgb.b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`.toUpperCase() }
          },
          alignment: { horizontal: 'center' }
        };
      }
    }

    legendWs['!cols'] = [{ wch: 15 }, { wch: 10 }, { wch: 20 }];

    // Add sheets to workbook
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Account Level Ratings');
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, legendWs, 'Color Legend');

    // Generate and download file
    XLSX.writeFile(wb, `Account_Level_Rating_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`);
  };

  if (!excelData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <LoadingMessage>
          Loading dashboard data...
        </LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (processedData?.error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          {processedData.error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (!processedData?.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          No data found in the CSAT received Report sheet
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📊 Account Level Rating Dashboard</Title>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadExcel}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download Excel
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </Header>

      <SearchContainer>
        <SearchTitle>
          🔍 Search Customer Name
        </SearchTitle>
        <SearchInputContainer>
          <SearchInput
            type="text"
            placeholder="Type customer name to search..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            style={{ paddingRight: searchTerm ? '4rem' : '1rem' }}
          />
          {searchTerm && (
            <ClearButton
              onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
              title="Clear search"
            >
              ✕ Clear
            </ClearButton>
          )}
        </SearchInputContainer>
        <SearchResults>
          {filteredData ? (
            searchTerm.trim() ? (
              `Found ${filteredData.length} of ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            ) : (
              `Showing all ${processedData.data.length} customers`
            )
          ) : (
            'No data available'
          )}
        </SearchResults>
      </SearchContainer>

      <LegendContainer>
        <LegendTitle>
          🎨 Rating Color Legend
        </LegendTitle>
        <LegendGrid>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#fef2f2', borderColor: '#dc2626' }} />
            <LegendText>&lt; 4.0 (Dark Red)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#fef3c7', borderColor: '#d97706' }} />
            <LegendText>4.0 - 4.49 (Dark Amber)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#d1fae5', borderColor: '#059669' }} />
            <LegendText>4.5 - 4.99 (Light Green)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
          <LegendItem>
            <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#bbf7d0', borderColor: '#047857' }} />
            <LegendText>= 5.0 (Dark Green)</LegendText>
          </LegendItem>
        </LegendGrid>
      </LegendContainer>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.businessUnit || 'BUSSINESS UNIT'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerId || 'CUSTOMER_ID'}</Th>
              <Th>{processedData.headers.customerName || 'CUSTOMER NAME'}</Th>
              {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                <Th key={perspective}>{perspective}</Th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <Tbody>
            {filteredData && filteredData.length > 0 ? (
              filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <Tr key={index}>
                  <BusinessUnitTd>{row.businessUnit}</BusinessUnitTd>
                  <CustomerIdTd>{row.customerId}</CustomerIdTd>
                  <CustomerNameTd>{row.customerName}</CustomerNameTd>
                  {processedData.headers.perspectives && processedData.headers.perspectives.map(perspective => (
                    <RatingCell key={perspective} rating={row[perspective]}>
                      {row[perspective] !== null ? row[perspective] : 'N/A'}
                    </RatingCell>
                  ))}
                </Tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Tr>
                <Td colSpan={3 + (processedData.headers.perspectives ? processedData.headers.perspectives.length : 0)} 
                     style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: '#6b7280' }}>
                  {searchTerm.trim() ? 'No customers found matching your search' : 'No data available'}
                </Td>
              </Tr>
            )}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
}

export default AccountLevelRatingDashboard;
```

```javascript
const XLSX = require('xlsx');
const path = require('path');

// Read the Excel file
const filePath = path.join(__dirname, 'data', 'ACSAT_ of New_customer_feedback_analysis.xlsx');
const workbook = XLSX.readFile(filePath);

// Get the "CSAT received Report" sheet
```
```javascript
const sheetName = 'CSAT received Report ';
if (!workbook.Sheets[sheetName]) {
  console.log('Available sheets:', Object.keys(workbook.Sheets));
  process.exit(1);
}
```

```javascript
const XLSX = require('xlsx');
const path = require('path');

// Read the Excel file
const filePath = path.join(__dirname, 'data', 'ACSAT_ of New_customer_feedback_analysis.xlsx');
const workbook = XLSX.readFile(filePath);

// Get the "CSAT received Report" sheet
const sheetName = 'CSAT received Report ';
const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];

// Convert to JSON to work with the data
const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });

console.log('Original structure:');
console.log('Total rows:', jsonData.length);
console.log('Total columns:', jsonData[0].length);

// Get the headers
const headers = jsonData[0];
const customerNameIndex = 0; // CUSTOMER NAME is at index 0
const customerIdIndex = 38; // CUSTOMER_ID is at index 38

console.log('\nColumn positions:');
console.log('CUSTOMER NAME at index:', customerNameIndex);
console.log('CUSTOMER_ID at index:', customerIdIndex);

// Create new column order
// Move CUSTOMER_ID to be right before CUSTOMER NAME
const newHeaders = [];
const newData = [];

// Process each row
jsonData.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
  const newRow = [];
  
  // Add CUSTOMER_ID first (if it exists)
  if (row[customerIdIndex] !== undefined) {
    newRow.push(row[customerIdIndex]);
  } else {
    newRow.push('');
  }
  
  // Add CUSTOMER NAME second (if it exists)
  if (row[customerNameIndex] !== undefined) {
    newRow.push(row[customerNameIndex]);
  } else {
    newRow.push('');
  }
  
  // Add all other columns except CUSTOMER_ID and CUSTOMER NAME
  row.forEach((cell, colIndex) => {
    if (colIndex !== customerNameIndex && colIndex !== customerIdIndex) {
      newRow.push(cell);
    }
  });
  
  newData.push(newRow);
});

// Update headers
const newHeadersArray = [
  'CUSTOMER_ID',
  'CUSTOMER NAME',
  ...headers.filter((header, index) => index !== customerNameIndex && index !== customerIdIndex)
];

console.log('\nNew column order:');
newHeadersArray.forEach((header, index) => {
  console.log(`Column ${index + 1}: "${header}"`);
});

// Create new worksheet
const newWorksheet = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(newData);

// Set the headers
newWorksheet['!ref'] = XLSX.utils.encode_range({
  s: { c: 0, r: 0 },
  e: { c: newHeadersArray.length - 1, r: newData.length - 1 }
});

// Update the first row with new headers
newHeadersArray.forEach((header, index) => {
  const cellAddress = XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ r: 0, c: index });
  newWorksheet[cellAddress] = { v: header };
});

// Update the workbook
workbook.Sheets[sheetName] = newWorksheet;

// Write the modified file
const outputPath = path.join(__dirname, 'data', 'ACSAT_ of New_customer_feedback_analysis_updated.xlsx');
XLSX.writeFile(workbook, outputPath);

console.log('\nFile updated successfully!');
console.log('New file saved as:', outputPath);
console.log('New structure:');
console.log('Total rows:', newData.length);
console.log('Total columns:', newHeadersArray.length);

// Verify the changes
const verifyData = newData.slice(0, 3);
console.log('\nFirst few rows of updated data:');
verifyData.forEach((row, index) => {
  console.log(`Row ${index + 1}:`, row.slice(0, 5)); // Show first 5 columns
});
```

```javascript
function AccountLevelRatingDashboard({ excelData, onBack }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

    if (!excelData) {

      return null;
    }
```
